kānyakubje ca deśe ca drumilo nāma rājakaḥ ..
kalāvatī tasya patnī vandhyā cāpi pativratā .. 12 ..
1.20.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
कान्यकुब्जे च देशे च द्रुमिलो नाम राजकः ॥
कलावती तस्य पत्नी वन्ध्या चापि पतिव्रता ॥ 12 ॥

1.20.s:
svāmidoṣeṇa sā vandhyā kāle ca bharturājñayā ..
upatasthe vane ghore nāradaṃ kāśyapaṃ munim .. 13 ..
1.20.d:
स्वामिदोषेण सा वन्ध्या काले च भर्तुराज्ञया ॥
उपतस्थे वने घोरे नारदं काश्यपं मुनिम् ॥ 13 ॥

1.20.s:
dhyāyamānaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ..
tasthau suveṣaṃ kṛtvā sā dhyānāntaṃ ca muneḥ puraḥ .. 14 ..
1.20.d:
ध्यायमानं च श्रीकृष्णं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥
तस्थौ सुवेषं कृत्वा सा ध्यानान्तं च मुनेः पुरः ॥ 14 ॥

1.20.s:
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhātulyena tejasā ..
tapantaṃ dūrato'pyevaṃ samīpaṃ gantumakṣamā .. 15 ..
1.20.d:
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्तण्डप्रभातुल्येन तेजसा ॥
तपन्तं दूरतोऽप्येवं समीपं गन्तुमक्षमा ॥ 15 ॥

1.20.s:
dhyānānte ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ paraḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ..
dadarśa purato dūre sundarīṃ sthirayauvanām .. 16 ..
1.20.d:
ध्यानान्ते च मुनिश्रेष्ठः परः कृष्णपरायणः ॥
ददर्श पुरतो दूरे सुन्दरीं स्थिरयौवनाम् ॥ 16 ॥

1.20.s:
cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 17 ..
1.20.d:
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभां शरत्पङ्कजलोचनाम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ 17 ॥

1.20.s:
bṛhannitambabhārārttāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ..
śobhitāṃ pītavastreṇa sasmitāṃ raktalocanām .. 18 ..
1.20.d:
बृहन्नितम्बभारार्त्तां पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम् ॥
शोभितां पीतवस्त्रेण सस्मितां रक्तलोचनाम् ॥ 18 ॥

1.20.s:
mohitāṃ munirūpeṇa kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām ..
darśayantīṃ stanaśroṇiṃ maithunāsaktacetasā .. .. 19 ..
1.20.d:
मोहितां मुनिरूपेण कामबाणप्रपीडिताम् ॥
दर्शयन्तीं स्तनश्रोणिं मैथुनासक्तचेतसा ॥ ॥ 19 ॥

1.20.s:
sindūrabindubhūṣāḍhyāṃ sucārukajjalojjvalām ..
padālaktakaśobhāḍhyāṃ rūpeṇaiva yathorvaśīm .. 1.20.20 ..
1.20.d:
सिन्दूरबिन्दुभूषाढ्यां सुचारुकज्जलोज्ज्वलाम् ॥
पदालक्तकशोभाढ्यां रूपेणैव यथोर्वशीम् ॥ 1.20.20 ॥

1.20.s:
muniḥ papraccha dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kā tvaṃ kāmini nirjane ..
kasya patnī kathaṃ vā'tra satyaṃ brūhi ca puṃścali ..21..
1.20.d:
मुनिः पप्रच्छ दृष्ट्वा तां का त्वं कामिनि निर्जने ॥
कस्य पत्नी कथं वाऽत्र सत्यं ब्रूहि च पुंश्चलि ॥21॥

1.20.s:
muneśca vacanaṃ śrutvā kampitā ca kalāvatī ..
uvāca vinayenaiva kṛtvā ca śrīhariṃ hṛdi .. 22 ..
1.20.d:
मुनेश्च वचनं श्रुत्वा कम्पिता च कलावती ॥
उवाच विनयेनैव कृत्वा च श्रीहरिं हृदि ॥ 22 ॥

1.20.s:
kalāvatyuvāca ..
gopikā'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha drumilasya ca kāminī ..
putrārthinī cāgatā'haṃ tvanmūlaṃ bharturājñayā .. 23 ..
1.20.d:
कलावत्युवाच ॥
गोपिकाऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठ द्रुमिलस्य च कामिनी ॥
पुत्रार्थिनी चागताऽहं त्वन्मूलं भर्तुराज्ञया ॥ 23 ॥

1.20.s:
vīryyādhānaṃ kuru mayi strī nopekṣyā hyupasthitā ..
tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā .. 24 ..
1.20.d:
वीर्य्याधानं कुरु मयि स्त्री नोपेक्ष्या ह्युपस्थिता ॥
तेजीयसां न दोषाय वह्नेः सर्वभुजो यथा ॥ 24 ॥

1.20.s:
vṛṣalīvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa munisattamaḥ ..
uvāca nītyaṃ satyaṃ ca kopaprasphuritādharaḥ .. 25 ..
1.20.d:
वृषलीवचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोप मुनिसत्तमः ॥
उवाच नीत्यं सत्यं च कोपप्रस्फुरिताधरः ॥ 25 ॥

1.20.s:
kāśyapa uvāca ..
yaḥ svalakṣmīṃ ca bhogārhāṃ parāya dātumicchati ..
taṃ sā tyajati mūḍhaṃ ca vedavāda iti dhruvam .. 26 ..
1.20.d:
काश्यप उवाच ॥
यः स्वलक्ष्मीं च भोगार्हां पराय दातुमिच्छति ॥
तं सा त्यजति मूढं च वेदवाद इति ध्रुवम् ॥ 26 ॥

1.20.s:
na tvaṃ drumilabhogārhā punareva bhaviṣyasi ..
viraktena svayaṃ tyaktā na gṛhṇāti ca tvāṃ punaḥ .. 27 ..
1.20.d:
न त्वं द्रुमिलभोगार्हा पुनरेव भविष्यसि ॥
विरक्तेन स्वयं त्यक्ता न गृह्णाति च त्वां पुनः ॥ 27 ॥

1.20.s:
yaḥ śūdrapatnīṃ gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ..
sa caṇḍālo bhavetsatyaṃ na karmārho dvijātiṣu .. 28 ..
1.20.d:
यः शूद्रपत्नीं गृह्णाति ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानदुर्बलः॥
स चण्डालो भवेत्सत्यं न कर्मार्हो द्विजातिषु ॥ 28 ॥

1.20.s:
pitṛśrāddhe ca yajñe ca śilāsparśe surārcane ..
adhikāraśca tasyaivamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. .. 29 ..
1.20.d:
पितृश्राद्धे च यज्ञे च शिलास्पर्शे सुरार्चने ॥
अधिकारश्च तस्यैवमित्याह कमलोद्भवः ॥ ॥ 29 ॥

1.20.s:
kumbhīpākaṃ svayaṃ yāti pātayitvā ca pūruṣān ..
mātāmahānsvātmanaśca daśa pūrvāndaśāparān .. 1.20.30 ..
1.20.d:
कुम्भीपाकं स्वयं याति पातयित्वा च पूरुषान् ॥
मातामहान्स्वात्मनश्च दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् ॥ 1.20.30 ॥

1.20.s:
tattarpaṇaṃ mūtrameva piṇḍaṃ sadyaḥ purīṣakam ..
śālagrāmasya tatsparśe copavāsastrirātrakam .. 31 ..
1.20.d:
तत्तर्पणं मूत्रमेव पिण्डं सद्यः पुरीषकम् ॥
शालग्रामस्य तत्स्पर्शे चोपवासस्त्रिरात्रकम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.20.m: If he touches a Śāligrāma stone, the expiation is a fast of three nights.

1.20.s:
tadiṣṭadevo gṛhṇāti na naivedyaṃ na tajjalam ..
saṃnyāsināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tadannaṃ ca purīṣavat .. 32 ..
1.20.d:
तदिष्टदेवो गृह्णाति न नैवेद्यं न तज्जलम् ॥
संन्यासिनां ब्राह्मणानां तदन्नं च पुरीषवत् ॥ 32 ॥
1.20.m:
His chosen deity accepts neither his food offering nor his water.
To renunciants and Brahmins, his food is like feces.

1.20.s:
kumbhīpāke pacyate sa śakrāntaṃ yāvadeva hi ..
ekaviṃśatipuruṣaiḥ sārddhaṃ satyaṃ ca puṃścali .. 33 ..
1.20.d:
कुम्भीपाके पच्यते स शक्रान्तं यावदेव हि ॥
एकविंशतिपुरुषैः सार्द्धं सत्यं च पुंश्चलि ॥ 33 ॥
1.20.m:
He is boiled in Kumbhīpāka hell until the end of Indra's reign,
together with twenty-one generations of men; this is the truth, unchaste woman!

1.20.s:
patrocchiṣṭaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte śūdrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ..
tattulyo'dharabhojī caivetyāṅgiresabhāṣitam .. 34 ..
1.20.d:
पत्रोच्छिष्टं च यो भुङ्क्ते शूद्राणां ब्राह्मणाधमः ॥
तत्तुल्योऽधरभोजी चैवेत्याङ्गिरेसभाषितम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.20.m:
A vile Brahmin who eats the leftover leaf-offering of Śūdras
is equal to that one, an eater of what is lower; so said Aṅgiras.

1.20.s:
śūdro vā yadi gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇīṃ jñānadurbalaḥ ..
sa pacyate kālasūtre yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 35 ..
1.20.d:
शूद्रो वा यदि गृह्णाति ब्राह्मणीं ज्ञानदुर्बलः ॥
स पच्यते कालसूत्रे यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥ 35 ॥
1.20.m:
Or if a Śūdra, weak in knowledge, takes a Brahmin woman,
he is boiled in the Kālasūtra hell as long as fourteen Indras reign.

1.20.s:
aṣṭādaśendrāvacchinnaṃ kālaṃ ca kālasūtrake..
brāhmaṇī pacyate tatra bhakṣitā krimibhirdhruvam .. 36 ..
1.20.d:
अष्टादशेन्द्रावच्छिन्नं कालं च कालसूत्रके॥
ब्राह्मणी पच्यते तत्र भक्षिता क्रिमिभिर्ध्रुवम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.20.m:
For a period measured by eighteen Indras, in the Kālasūtra hell,
the Brahmin woman is boiled there, constantly devoured by worms.

1.20.s:
tataścaṇḍālayonau ca labdhvā janma ca brāhmaṇī ..
śūdraśca kuṣṭhī bhavati jñātibhiḥ parivarjitaḥ .. 37 ..
1.20.d:
ततश्चण्डालयोनौ च लब्ध्वा जन्म च ब्राह्मणी ॥
शूद्रश्च कुष्ठी भवति ज्ञातिभिः परिवर्जितः ॥ 37 ॥
1.20.m:
Then, having obtained birth in the womb of an outcaste, that Brahmin woman,
and that Śūdra, becomes a leper, abandoned by his kinsmen.”

1.20.s:
ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho virarāma ca śaunaka ..
vṛṣalī tatpurastasthau śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā .. 38 ..
1.20.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च मुनिश्रेष्ठो विरराम च शौनक ॥
वृषली तत्पुरस्तस्थौ शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुका ॥ 38 ॥
1.20.m:
Having spoken thus, O Śaunaka, the best of sages fell silent.
The Śūdra woman stood before him, her throat, lips, and palate dried up.

1.20.s:
etasminnantare tena pathā yāti ca menakā ..
tasyā ūruṃ stanaṃ dṛṣṭvā munervīryyaṃ papāta ha .. 39 ..
1.20.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेन पथा याति च मेनका ॥
तस्या ऊरुं स्तनं दृष्ट्वा मुनेर्वीर्य्यं पपात ह ॥ 39 ॥
1.20.m:
In the meantime, Menakā passed along that path.
Seeing her thigh and breast, the sage's semen fell.

1.20.s:
ṛtusnātā ca vṛṣalī pītvā tatra kṣaṇaṃ mudā ..
muniṃ praṇamya prahṛṣṭā prayayau bharturantikam .. 1.20.40 ..
1.20.d:
ऋतुस्नाता च वृषली पीत्वा तत्र क्षणं मुदा ॥
मुनिं प्रणम्य प्रहृष्टा प्रययौ भर्तुरन्तिकम् ॥ 1.20.40 ॥
1.20.m:
And the Śūdra woman, who had bathed after her period, gladly drank it in that moment;
bowing to the sage, overjoyed, she went to her husband's presence.

1.20.s:
gatvā praṇamya drumilaṃ kāntā kāntaṃ manoharam ..
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa vṛttāṃttaṃ garbhahetukam ..41..
1.20.d:
गत्वा प्रणम्य द्रुमिलं कान्ता कान्तं मनोहरम् ॥
सर्वं निवेदयामास वृत्तांत्तं गर्भहेतुकम् ॥41॥
1.20.m:
Having gone and bowed to Drumila, that lovely woman reported to her charming beloved
the entire account that was the cause of her pregnancy.

1.20.s:
kalāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭavadanekṣaṇaḥ ..
uvāca kāntāṃ madhuraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 42 ..
1.20.d:
कलावतीवचः श्रुत्वा प्रहृष्टवदनेक्षणः ॥
उवाच कान्तां मधुरं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.20.m:
Hearing Kalāvatī's words, his face and eyes filled with joy,
he spoke sweet words to his beloved, bringing happiness in their outcome: / 42

1.20.s:
drumila uvāca ..
viprasya vīryaṃ tvadgarbhe vaiṣṇavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vaiṣṇavo bhavitā bālastvaṃ ca bhāgyavatī satī ..43..
1.20.d:
द्रुमिल उवाच ॥
विप्रस्य वीर्यं त्वद्गर्भे वैष्णवस्य महात्मनः ॥
वैष्णवो भविता बालस्त्वं च भाग्यवती सती ॥43॥
1.20.m:
"In your womb is the seed of a brāhmaṇa, a great-souled Vaiṣṇava;
the child will be a Vaiṣṇava, and you are fortunate and chaste. / 43

1.20.s:
yadgarbhe vaiṣṇavo jāto yasya vīryeṇa vā sati ..
tayoryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam ..44..
1.20.d:
यद्गर्भे वैष्णवो जातो यस्य वीर्येण वा सति ॥
तयोर्याति च वैकुण्ठं पुरुषाणां शतं शतम् ॥44॥
1.20.m:
In whose womb a Vaiṣṇava is born, or by whose seed, O chaste woman,
hundreds upon hundreds of ancestors of both of them go to Vaikuṇṭha. / 44

1.20.s:
tau ca viṣṇuvimānena sadratnanirmitena ca ..
yātau vaikuṇṭhanagaraṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam .. 45 ..
1.20.d:
तौ च विष्णुविमानेन सद्रत्ननिर्मितेन च ॥
यातौ वैकुण्ठनगरं जन्ममृत्युजराहरम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.20.m:
And the two of them, by a vimāna of Viṣṇu fashioned from fine gems,
go to the city of Vaikuṇṭha, which takes away birth, death, and old age. / 45

1.20.s:
kasyacidbrāhmaṇasyaiva gehaṃ gaccha śubhānane ..
paścānmamāntikaṃ bhadre yāsyasīti hareḥ puram .. 46 ..
1.20.d:
कस्यचिद्ब्राह्मणस्यैव गेहं गच्छ शुभानने ॥
पश्चान्ममान्तिकं भद्रे यास्यसीति हरेः पुरम् ॥ 46 ॥
1.20.m:
Go to the house of some brāhmaṇa, O fair-faced woman;
afterwards, O auspicious one, you will come to my presence in the city of Hari." / 46

1.20.s:
ityuktvā goparājaśca snātvā kṛtvā tu tarpaṇam ..
saṃpūjyābhīṣṭadevaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau .. 47 ..
1.20.d:
इत्युक्त्वा गोपराजश्च स्नात्वा कृत्वा तु तर्पणम् ॥
संपूज्याभीष्टदेवं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं ददौ ॥ 47 ॥
1.20.m:
Having spoken thus, the king of cowherds bathed, performed his tarpaṇa,
worshipped his chosen deity, and gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas: / 47

1.20.s:
aśvānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ gajānāṃ lakṣameva ca ..
śataṃ mattagajendrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 48 ..
1.20.d:
अश्वानां च चतुर्लक्षं गजानां लक्षमेव च ॥
शतं मत्तगजेन्द्राणां ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 48 ॥
1.20.m:
Four hundred thousand horses, a hundred thousand elephants,
and a hundred rutting lordly elephants he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 48

1.20.s:
uccaiḥśravaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca sahasrakam ..
śakaṭānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 49 ..
1.20.d:
उच्चैःश्रवः पञ्चलक्षं रथानां च सहस्रकम् ॥
शकटानां त्रिलक्षं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 49 ॥
1.20.m:
Five hundred thousand [horses like] Uccaiḥśravas, a thousand chariots,
and three hundred thousand carts he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 49

1.20.s:
gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣaṃ ca mahiṣāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ..
trilakṣaṃ rājahaṃsānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 1.20.50 ..
1.20.d:
गवां द्वादशलक्षं च महिषाणां त्रिलक्षकम् ॥
त्रिलक्षं राजहंसानां ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 1.20.50 ॥
1.20.m:
Twelve hundred thousand cows, three hundred thousand buffaloes,
and three hundred thousand royal swans he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 1.20.50

1.20.s:
pārāvatānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca śukānāṃ ca śataṃ mune ..
lakṣaṃ ca dāsadāsīnāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 51 ..
1.20.d:
पारावतानां लक्षं च शुकानां च शतं मुने ॥
लक्षं च दासदासीनां ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 51 ॥
1.20.m:
A hundred thousand pigeons, and a hundred parrots, O sage,
and a hundred thousand male and female servants he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 51

1.20.s:
grāmāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca nagarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam ..
dhānyataṇḍulaśailaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā..52..
1.20.d:
ग्रामाणां च सहस्रं च नगराणां शतं शतम् ॥
धान्यतण्डुलशैलं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा॥52॥
1.20.m:
A thousand villages, hundreds upon hundreds of cities,
and mountains of grain and rice he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 52

1.20.s:
śatakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ ratnānāṃ ca sahasrakam..
mudrāṇāṃ koṭikalaśaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 53 ..
1.20.d:
शतकोटिं सुवर्णानां रत्नानां च सहस्रकम्॥
मुद्राणां कोटिकलशं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 53 ॥
1.20.m:
A hundred crores of gold coins, a thousand gems,
and a crore of jars filled with coins he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 53

1.20.s:
dadau taijasapātrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāmasaṃkhyakam ..
tāṃ striyaṃ ratnabhūṣāḍhyāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ..54..
1.20.d:
ददौ तैजसपात्राणां भूषणानामसंख्यकम् ॥
तां स्त्रियं रत्नभूषाढ्यां ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥54॥
1.20.m:
He gave innumerable metallic vessels and ornaments;
that woman, richly adorned with gem ornaments, he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. / 54

1.20.s:
rājyaṃ dattvā mahārājo'pyantarbāhye hariṃ smaran ..
jagāma badarīṃ gopo manogāmī mudā'nvitaḥ.55..
1.20.d:
राज्यं दत्त्वा महाराजोऽप्यन्तर्बाह्ये हरिं स्मरन् ॥
जगाम बदरीं गोपो मनोगामी मुदाऽन्वितः.55॥
1.20.m:
Having given away his kingdom, the great king, remembering Hari internally and externally,
the cowherd went with joy to Badarī, travelling at the speed of thought. / 55

1.20.s:
tatra māsaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā gaṅgātīre manohare ..
prāṇāṃstatyāja yogena sadyo dṛṣṭo maharṣibhiḥ ..56..
1.20.d:
तत्र मासं तपः कृत्वा गङ्गातीरे मनोहरे ॥
प्राणांस्तत्याज योगेन सद्यो दृष्टो महर्षिभिः ॥56॥
1.20.m:
Performing austerities there for a month on the charming bank of the Gaṅgā,
he abandoned his life-breaths through yoga, witnessed at once by great sages. / 56

1.20.s:
sa ca viṣṇuvimānena ratnendranirmitena ca..
saṃyukto viṣṇudūtaiśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha..57..
1.20.d:
स च विष्णुविमानेन रत्नेन्द्रनिर्मितेन च॥
संयुक्तो विष्णुदूतैश्च वैकुण्ठं च जगाम ह॥57॥
1.20.m:
And he, by a vimāna of Viṣṇu fashioned from excellent gems,
accompanied by the messengers of Viṣṇu, went to Vaikuṇṭha. / 57

1.20.s:
tatra prāpa harerdāsyaṃ haridāso babhūva saḥ ..
vṛttāntaṃ ca kalāvatyā śrūyatāmiti śaunaka .. 58 ..
1.20.d:
तत्र प्राप हरेर्दास्यं हरिदासो बभूव सः ॥
वृत्तान्तं च कलावत्या श्रूयतामिति शौनक ॥ 58 ॥
1.20.m:
There he attained servitude to Hari and became a servant of Hari.
Now hear the account of Kalāvatī, O Śaunaka: / 58

1.20.s:
gate kalāvatī nāthe uccaiśca praruroda ha ..
vahnau prāṇāṃstyaktukāmā brāhmaṇenaiva rakṣitā .. 59 ..
1.20.d:
गते कलावती नाथे उच्चैश्च प्ररुरोद ह ॥
वह्नौ प्राणांस्त्यक्तुकामा ब्राह्मणेनैव रक्षिता ॥ 59 ॥
1.20.m:
When her husband had departed, Kalāvatī wept aloud.
Desiring to cast her life into fire, she was saved by a brāhmaṇa. / 59

1.20.s:
brāhmaṇo mātarityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā mudā'nvitaḥ ..
jagāma ratnapūrṇaṃ ca svagehaṃ ca kṣaṇena ca .. 1.20.60 ..
1.20.d:
ब्राह्मणो मातरित्युक्त्वा तां गृहीत्वा मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
जगाम रत्नपूर्णं च स्वगेहं च क्षणेन च ॥ 1.20.60 ॥
1.20.m:
The brāhmaṇa, saying "Mother!", took her with joy,
and in an instant went to his own home, which was filled with gems. / 1.20.60

1.20.s:
sā vipragehe sādhvī ca suṣāva tanayaṃ varam ..
taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā .. 61 ..
1.20.d:
सा विप्रगेहे साध्वी च सुषाव तनयं वरम् ॥
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 61 ॥
1.20.m:
In that brāhmaṇa's house, the virtuous woman gave birth to an excellent son,
radiant with the hue of molten gold, blazing with Brahmanic splendour. / 61

1.20.s:
tatrasthā yoṣitaḥ sarvā dadṛśurbālakaṃ śubham ..
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍajitaṃ taṃ brahmatejasā .. 62 ..
1.20.d:
तत्रस्था योषितः सर्वा ददृशुर्बालकं शुभम् ॥
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्तण्डजितं तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 62 ॥
1.20.m:
All the women present there beheld the auspicious child,
who surpassed the midday summer sun in Brahmanic splendour; / 62

1.20.s:
kāmadevādhikaṃ rūpe candrādhikaśubhānanam ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam .. 63 ..
1.20.d:
कामदेवाधिकं रूपे चन्द्राधिकशुभाननम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यं शरत्पङ्कजलोचनम् ॥ 63 ॥
1.20.m: surpassing Kāmadeva in beauty, with an auspicious face surpassing the moon;

1.20.s:
hastapādādivalitaṃ sukapolaṃ manoharam ..
padmacakrāṅkitaṃ pādapadmaṃ vā'tulamujjvalam .. 64 ..
1.20.d:
हस्तपादादिवलितं सुकपोलं मनोहरम् ॥
पद्मचक्राङ्कितं पादपद्मं वाऽतुलमुज्ज्वलम् ॥ 64 ॥
1.20.m:
with well-rounded hands, feet, and limbs, with beautiful, charming cheeks;
his peerless, radiant lotus feet marked with a lotus and a discus; / 64

1.20.s:
karayugmaṃ vā'tulaṃ ca rudantaṃ ca stanārthinam ..
yoṣito bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayuḥ svāśramaṃ mudā .. 65 ..
putradārayuto vipraḥ prahṛṣṭaśca nanarta ha ..
sa bālo vavṛdhe tatra śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī .. 65 ..
1.20.d:
करयुग्मं वाऽतुलं च रुदन्तं च स्तनार्थिनम् ॥
योषितो बालकं दृष्ट्वा प्रययुः स्वाश्रमं मुदा ॥ 65 ॥
पुत्रदारयुतो विप्रः प्रहृष्टश्च ननर्त ह ॥
स बालो ववृधे तत्र शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी ॥ 65 ॥
1.20.m:
his pair of hands likewise matchless, crying out and longing for the breast.
Having seen the child, the women gladly departed to their own hermitage. / 65
Together with his sons and wife, the delighted brāhmaṇa danced indeed.
The child grew there like the moon in the bright fortnight. / 65

1.20.s: pupoṣa brāhmaṇastāṃ ca saputrāṃ ca yathā sutām .. 66 ..
1.20.d: पुपोष ब्राह्मणस्तां च सपुत्रां च यथा सुताम् ॥ 66 ॥
1.20.m: The brāhmaṇa nourished her and her son just like his own daughter. / 66

1.21.s:
sautiruvāca ..
babhūva kāle bālaśca krameṇa pañcahāyanaḥ ..
jātismaro jñānayuktaḥ pūrvamantrasmṛtaḥ sadā ..1 ..
1.21.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
बभूव काले बालश्च क्रमेण पञ्चहायनः ॥
जातिस्मरो ज्ञानयुक्तः पूर्वमन्त्रस्मृतः सदा ॥1 ॥

1.21.s:
gīyate satataṃ kṛṣṇayaśonāmaguṇādikam ..
kṣaṇaṃ roditi nṛtyena pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ .. 2 ..
1.21.d:
गीयते सततं कृष्णयशोनामगुणादिकम् ॥
क्षणं रोदिति नृत्येन पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहः ॥ 2 ॥

1.21.s:
kṛṣṇasambandhinīṃ gāthāṃ śṛṇoti yatra tatra vai ..
tatsambandhi purāṇaṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhati bālakaḥ .. 3 ..
1.21.d:
कृष्णसम्बन्धिनीं गाथां शृणोति यत्र तत्र वै ॥
तत्सम्बन्धि पुराणं च तत्र तिष्ठति बालकः ॥ 3 ॥

1.21.s:
dhūlidhūsarasarvāṅgo dhūlinaivedyamīpsitam ..
dhūliṣu pratimāṃ kṛtvā dhūlinā pūjayeddharim .. 4 ..
1.21.d:
धूलिधूसरसर्वाङ्गो धूलिनैवेद्यमीप्सितम् ॥
धूलिषु प्रतिमां कृत्वा धूलिना पूजयेद्धरिम् ॥ 4 ॥

1.21.s:
putramāhvayate mātā prātarāśāya cenmune ..
hariṃ saṃpūjayāmīti mātaraṃ saṃvadetpunaḥ.. 5 ..
1.21.d:
पुत्रमाह्वयते माता प्रातराशाय चेन्मुने ॥
हरिं संपूजयामीति मातरं संवदेत्पुनः॥ 5 ॥

1.21.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kiṃ nāma bālakasyāsya janmanyatra babhūva ha ..
vyutpattyā saṃjñayā vā'pi tadbhavānvaktumarhati .. 6 ..
1.21.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
किं नाम बालकस्यास्य जन्मन्यत्र बभूव ह ॥
व्युत्पत्त्या संज्ञया वाऽपि तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥ 6 ॥

1.21.s:
sautiruvāca ..
anāvṛṣṭyavaśeṣe ca kāle bālo babhūva ha ..
nāraṃ dadau janmakāle tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ ..7..
1.21.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
अनावृष्ट्यवशेषे च काले बालो बभूव ह ॥
नारं ददौ जन्मकाले तेनायं नारदाभिधः ॥7॥

1.21.s:
dadāti nāraṃ jñānaṃ ca bālakebhyaśca bālakaḥ ..
jātismaro mahājñānī tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ .. 8 ..
1.21.d:
ददाति नारं ज्ञानं च बालकेभ्यश्च बालकः ॥
जातिस्मरो महाज्ञानी तेनायं नारदाभिधः ॥ 8 ॥

1.21.s:
vīryeṇa nāradasyaiva babhūva bālako mune ..
munīndrasya vareṇaiva tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ .. 9 ..
1.21.d:
वीर्येण नारदस्यैव बभूव बालको मुने ॥
मुनीन्द्रस्य वरेणैव तेनायं नारदाभिधः ॥ 9 ॥

1.21.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
śiśunāma ca vijñātaṃ vyutpattyā ca yathocitam ..
munīndrasya kathaṃ nāma nāradaśceti maṃgalam .. 1.21.10 ..
1.21.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
शिशुनाम च विज्ञातं व्युत्पत्त्या च यथोचितम् ॥
मुनीन्द्रस्य कथं नाम नारदश्चेति मंगलम् ॥ 1.21.10 ॥

1.21.s:
sautiruvāca ..
aputrakāya viprāya dharmaputro naro muniḥ ..
dadau putra kaśyapāya tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ .. 11 ..
1.21.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
अपुत्रकाय विप्राय धर्मपुत्रो नरो मुनिः ॥
ददौ पुत्र कश्यपाय तेनायं नारदाभिधः ॥ 11 ॥

1.21.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
adhunā nāmavyutpattiḥ śrutā saute śiśorapi ..
śūdrayonau brahmaputraḥ kathaṃ sa nāradābhidhaḥ .. 12 ..
1.21.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
अधुना नामव्युत्पत्तिः श्रुता सौते शिशोरपि ॥
शूद्रयोनौ ब्रह्मपुत्रः कथं स नारदाभिधः ॥ 12 ॥

1.21.s:
sautiruvāca ..
kalpāntare brahmakaṇṭhādbabhūvurbahavo narāḥ ..
narāndadau tatkaṇṭhaṃ ca tena tannāradaṃ smṛtam ..13..
1.21.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
कल्पान्तरे ब्रह्मकण्ठाद्बभूवुर्बहवो नराः ॥
नरान्ददौ तत्कण्ठं च तेन तन्नारदं स्मृतम् ॥13॥

1.21.s:
tato babhūva bālaśca nāradātkaṇṭhadeśataḥ ..
ato brahmā nāma cakre nāradaśceti maṅgalam .. 14 ..
1.21.d:
ततो बभूव बालश्च नारदात्कण्ठदेशतः ॥
अतो ब्रह्मा नाम चक्रे नारदश्चेति मङ्गलम् ॥ 14 ॥

1.21.s:
sāmprataṃ śiśuvṛttāntaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ..
upālambharahasyena viśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ prayojanam .. 15 ..
1.21.d:
साम्प्रतं शिशुवृत्तान्तं सावधानं निशामय ॥
उपालम्भरहस्येन विशिष्टं किं प्रयोजनम् ॥ 15 ॥

1.21.s:
vavṛdhe gopikābālo vipragehe dinedine ..
saputrāṃ pālitāṃ cakre brāhmaṇaḥ svasutāṃ yathā ..16 ..
1.21.d:
ववृधे गोपिकाबालो विप्रगेहे दिनेदिने ॥
सपुत्रां पालितां चक्रे ब्राह्मणः स्वसुतां यथा ॥16 ॥

1.21.s:
etasminnantare viprā āyayurvipramandiram ..
śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā mahātejasvino yathā .. 17 ..
1.21.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्रा आययुर्विप्रमन्दिरम् ॥
शिशवः पञ्चवर्षीया महातेजस्विनो यथा ॥ 17 ॥

1.21.s:
pracchannaṃ hṛtavantaśca grīṣmamadhyāhnabhāskaram ..
madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā tānnanāma gṛhī dvija .. 18 ..
1.21.d:
प्रच्छन्नं हृतवन्तश्च ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नभास्करम् ॥
मधुपर्कादिकं दत्त्वा तान्ननाम गृही द्विज ॥ 18 ॥

1.21.s:
phalamūlādikaṃ kāle catvāro munipuṅgavāḥ ..
vipradattaṃ bubhujire taccheśaṃ bubhuje śiśuḥ .. 19 ..
1.21.d:
फलमूलादिकं काले चत्वारो मुनिपुङ्गवाः ॥
विप्रदत्तं बुभुजिरे तच्छेशं बुभुजे शिशुः ॥ 19 ॥

1.21.s:
caturthako munistasmai kṛṣṇamantraṃ dadau mudā ..
teṣāṃ babhūva dāsaḥ sa dvijasya māturājñayā ..1.21.20..
1.21.d:
चतुर्थको मुनिस्तस्मै कृष्णमन्त्रं ददौ मुदा ॥
तेषां बभूव दासः स द्विजस्य मातुराज्ञया ॥1.21.20॥

1.21.s:
ekadā śiśumātā ca gacchantī niśi vartmani ..
mamāra sarpadaṣṭā ca tatkṣaṇaṃ smaratī harim .. 21 ..
1.21.d:
एकदा शिशुमाता च गच्छन्ती निशि वर्त्मनि ॥
ममार सर्पदष्टा च तत्क्षणं स्मरती हरिम् ॥ 21 ॥

1.21.s:
sadyo jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇuyānena sā satī ..
viṣṇupārṣadasaṃyuktā sadratnanirmitena ca .. 22 ..
1.21.d:
सद्यो जगाम वैकुण्ठं विष्णुयानेन सा सती ॥
विष्णुपार्षदसंयुक्ता सद्रत्ननिर्मितेन च ॥ 22 ॥

1.21.s:
prātarbālo dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ prayayau vipramandirāt ..
tattvajñānaṃ dadustasmai brāhmaṇāśca kṛpālavaḥ .. 23 ..
1.21.d:
प्रातर्बालो द्विजैः सार्धं प्रययौ विप्रमन्दिरात् ॥
तत्त्वज्ञानं ददुस्तस्मै ब्राह्मणाश्च कृपालवः ॥ 23 ॥

1.21.s:
brahmaputrāḥ śiśuṃ tyaktvā svasthānaṃ prayayuḥ kila ..
mahājñānī śiśustasthau gaṅgātīre manohare ..24 ..
1.21.d:
ब्रह्मपुत्राः शिशुं त्यक्त्वा स्वस्थानं प्रययुः किल ॥
महाज्ञानी शिशुस्तस्थौ गङ्गातीरे मनोहरे ॥24 ॥

1.21.s:
tatra snātvā vipradattaṃ viṣṇumantraṃ jajāpa saḥ ..
kṣutpipāsārogaśokaharaṃ vedeṣu durlabham .. 25 ..
1.21.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा विप्रदत्तं विष्णुमन्त्रं जजाप सः ॥
क्षुत्पिपासारोगशोकहरं वेदेषु दुर्लभम् ॥ 25 ॥

1.21.s:
mahāraṇye ca ghore ca aśvatthamūlasannidhau ..
kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ tasthau suciraṃ tatra bālakaḥ .. 26 ..
1.21.d:
महारण्ये च घोरे च अश्वत्थमूलसन्निधौ ॥
कृत्वा योगासनं तस्थौ सुचिरं तत्र बालकः ॥ 26 ॥
1.21.m:
And in the deep, dreadful forest, near the foot of an aśvattha tree,
having assumed a yogic posture, the boy remained there for a long time.

1.21.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kaṃ mantraṃ bālakaḥ prāpa kumāreṇa ca dhīmatā ..
dattaṃ paraṃ śrīṃhareśca tadbhavānvaktu marhati .. 27 ..
1.21.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
कं मन्त्रं बालकः प्राप कुमारेण च धीमता ॥
दत्तं परं श्रींहरेश्च तद्भवान्वक्तु मर्हति ॥ 27 ॥
1.21.m:
Which mantra did the boy receive from the wise Kumāra,
the supreme mantra of glorious Hari that was given? You ought to tell that.

1.21.s:
sautiruvāca ..
kṛṣṇena datto goloke kṛpayā brahmaṇe purā ..
dvāviṃśatyakṣaro mantro vedeṣu ca sudurlabhaḥ .. 28 ..
1.21.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
कृष्णेन दत्तो गोलोके कृपया ब्रह्मणे पुरा ॥
द्वाविंशत्यक्षरो मन्त्रो वेदेषु च सुदुर्लभः ॥ 28 ॥
1.21.m:
Formerly in Goloka, Kṛṣṇa mercifully gave to Brahmā
a mantra of twenty-two syllables, exceedingly hard to attain in the Vedas.

1.21.s:
taṃ ca brahmā dadau bhaktyā kumārāya ca dhīmate ..
kumāreṇa sa dattaśca mantraśca śiśave dvija .. 29 ..
1.21.d:
तं च ब्रह्मा ददौ भक्त्या कुमाराय च धीमते ॥
कुमारेण स दत्तश्च मन्त्रश्च शिशवे द्विज ॥ 29 ॥
1.21.m:
And Brahmā with devotion gave it to the wise Kumāra;
and by Kumāra that mantra was given to the child, O twice-born.

1.21.s:
oṃ śrīṃ namo bhagavate rāsa maṇḍaleśvarāya ..
śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca mantro'yaṃ kalpapādapaḥ .. 1.21.30 ..
1.21.d:
ओं श्रीं नमो भगवते रास मण्डलेश्वराय ॥
श्रीकृष्णाय स्वाहेति च मन्त्रोऽयं कल्पपादपः ॥ 1.21.30 ॥
1.21.m:
"Oṃ Śrīṃ, obeisance to the Blessed One, the Lord of the Rāsa-circle,
to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Svāhā"—this mantra is indeed a wish-fulfilling tree.

1.21.s:
mahāpuruṣastotraṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kavacaṃ ca yat ..
asyaupayaugikaṃ dhyānaṃ sāmavedoktameva ca .. 31 ..
1.21.d:
महापुरुषस्तोत्रं च पूर्वोक्तं कवचं च यत् ॥
अस्यौपयौगिकं ध्यानं सामवेदोक्तमेव च ॥ 31 ॥
1.21.m:
The hymn of praise to the Supreme Person and the armour that was previously mentioned,
as well as the meditation useful for this [mantra], are proclaimed in the Sāmaveda.

1.21.s:
tejomaṇḍalarūpe ca sūryyakoṭisamaprabhe ..
yogibhirvāñchitaṃ dhyāne yogaiḥ siddhagaṇaiḥ suraiḥ .. 32 ..
1.21.d:
तेजोमण्डलरूपे च सूर्य्यकोटिसमप्रभे ॥
योगिभिर्वाञ्छितं ध्याने योगैः सिद्धगणैः सुरैः ॥ 32 ॥
1.21.m:
In the orb of light, possessing splendour equal to ten million suns,
desired in meditation by yogins, by yoga practitioners, hosts of Siddhas, and gods,

1.21.s:
dhyāyante vaiṣṇavā rūpaṃ tadabhyantarasannidhau ..
atīva kamanīyānirvacanīyaṃ manoharam .. 33 ..
1.21.d:
ध्यायन्ते वैष्णवा रूपं तदभ्यन्तरसन्निधौ ॥
अतीव कमनीयानिर्वचनीयं मनोहरम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.21.m:
Vaiṣṇavas meditate upon the form within its interior:
exceedingly charming, indescribable, captivating the mind,

1.21.s:
navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ pakvabimbādhikādharam .. 34 ..
1.21.d:
नवीनजलदश्यामं शरत्पङ्कजलोचनम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यं पक्वबिम्बाधिकाधरम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.21.m:
dark as a fresh rain-cloud, with eyes like autumn lotuses,
with a face like the autumn full moon, with lips surpassing the ripe bimba fruit,

1.21.s:
muktāpaṅktivinindaikadantapaṃktimanoharam ..
sasmitaṃ muralīnyastahastāvalambanena ca .. 35 ..
1.21.d:
मुक्तापङ्क्तिविनिन्दैकदन्तपंक्तिमनोहरम् ॥
सस्मितं मुरलीन्यस्तहस्तावलम्बनेन च ॥ 35 ॥
1.21.m:
enchanting with a row of unique teeth that mocks a row of pearls,
smiling, with a hand resting upon a flute,

1.21.s:
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma manoharam ..
candralakṣaprabhājuṣṭaṃ puṣṭaśrīyuktavigraham .. 36 ..
1.21.d:
कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्यं लीलाधाम मनोहरम् ॥
चन्द्रलक्षप्रभाजुष्टं पुष्टश्रीयुक्तविग्रहम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.21.m: endowed with the splendour of a hundred thousand moons, his body possessed of abundant majesty,

1.21.s:
tribhaṅgasaṅgi vā yuktaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ..
ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣi tam .. 37 ..
1.21.d:
त्रिभङ्गसङ्गि वा युक्तं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् ॥
रत्नकेयूरवलयरत्ननूपुरभूषि तम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.21.m: bent gracefully in three places, two-armed, clad in yellow garments,

1.21.s:
ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ..
mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvibhūṣitam .. 38 ..
1.21.d:
रत्नकुण्डलयुग्मेन गण्डस्थलविराजितम् ॥
मयूरपुच्छचूडं च रत्नमालाविभूषितम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.21.m: wearing a crest of peacock feathers and adorned with a garland of jewels,

1.21.s:
śobhitaṃ jānuparyyantaṃ mālatīvanamālayā ..
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ..39 ..
1.21.d:
शोभितं जानुपर्य्यन्तं मालतीवनमालया ॥
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ॥39 ॥
1.21.m:
beautified down to his knees with a garland of forest jasmine,
his entire body anointed with sandalwood paste, bestowing grace upon his devotees,

1.21.s:
maṇinā kaustubhendreṇa vakṣasthalasamujjvalam ..
vīkṣitaṃ gopikābhiśca śaśvadvrīḍitalocanaiḥ ..1.21.40..
1.21.d:
मणिना कौस्तुभेन्द्रेण वक्षस्थलसमुज्ज्वलम् ॥
वीक्षितं गोपिकाभिश्च शश्वद्व्रीडितलोचनैः ॥1.21.40॥
1.21.m:
his chest brilliantly radiant with the lordly Kaustubha jewel,
gazed upon by the cowherd women with constantly bashful eyes,

1.21.s:
sthirayauvanayuktābhirveṣṭitābhiśca santatam ..
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitābhiśca rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam .. .. 41 ..
1.21.d:
स्थिरयौवनयुक्ताभिर्वेष्टिताभिश्च सन्ततम् ॥
भूषणैर्भूषिताभिश्च राधावक्षःस्थलस्थितम् ॥ ॥ 41 ॥
1.21.m:
surrounded perpetually by those endowed with unfading youth
and adorned with ornaments, resting against Rādhā's breast,

1.21.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca pūjitaṃ vanditaṃ stutam ..
kiśoraṃ rādhikākāntaṃ śāntarūpaṃ parātparam .. 42 ..
1.21.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाद्यैश्च पूजितं वन्दितं स्तुतम् ॥
किशोरं राधिकाकान्तं शान्तरूपं परात्परम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.21.m:
worshipped, saluted, and praised by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others,
an adolescent youth, the beloved of Rādhikā, of peaceful form, higher than the highest,

1.21.s:
nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ..
dhyāyetsarveśvaraṃ taṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram .. 43 ..
1.21.d:
निर्लिप्तं साक्षिरूपं च निर्गुणं प्रकृतेः परम् ॥
ध्यायेत्सर्वेश्वरं तं च परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.21.m: one should meditate upon him, the Lord of all, Paramātman, the Supreme Lord.

1.21.s:
idaṃ te kathitaṃ dhyānaṃ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mune ..
mantropayaugikaṃ satyaṃ mantraśca kalpapādapaḥ..44..
1.21.d:
इदं ते कथितं ध्यानं स्तोत्रं च कवचं मुने ॥
मन्त्रोपयौगिकं सत्यं मन्त्रश्च कल्पपादपः॥44॥
1.21.m:
This meditation has been spoken to you, along with the hymn of praise and the armour, O sage,
which are truly useful for the mantra; and the mantra is a wish-fulfilling tree.

1.21.s:
sāmprataṃ bālakastasthau dhyānasthastatra śaunaka ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ.. ..45..
1.21.d:
साम्प्रतं बालकस्तस्थौ ध्यानस्थस्तत्र शौनक ॥
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं च निराहारः कृशोदरः॥ ॥45॥
1.21.m:
Then the boy remained absorbed in meditation there, O Śaunaka,
for a thousand celestial years, without food, his belly emaciated,

1.21.s:
śaktimānparipuṣṭaśca siddhamantraprabhāvata..
dadarśa bālako dhyāne divyaṃ lokaṃ ca bālakam..46..
1.21.d:
शक्तिमान्परिपुष्टश्च सिद्धमन्त्रप्रभावत॥
ददर्श बालको ध्याने दिव्यं लोकं च बालकम्॥46॥
1.21.m:
yet powerful and fully invigorated through the power of the perfected mantra.
In meditation, the boy beheld a celestial realm and a boy,

1.21.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
kiśoravayasaṃ śyāmaṃ gopaveṣaṃ ca sasmitam .. 47 ..
1.21.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥
किशोरवयसं श्यामं गोपवेषं च सस्मितम् ॥ 47 ॥
1.21.m: youthful in age, dark-complexioned, dressed as a cowherd, and smiling,

1.21.s:
gopairgopāṅganābhiśca veṣṭitaṃ pītavāsasam ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ candanena vicarcitam..48..
1.21.d:
गोपैर्गोपाङ्गनाभिश्च वेष्टितं पीतवाससम् ॥
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं चन्दनेन विचर्चितम्॥48॥
1.21.m:
surrounded by cowherds and cowherd women, wearing yellow garments,
two-armed, holding a flute, anointed with sandalwood paste,

1.21.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca stūyamānaṃ parātparam ..
dṛṣṭvā ca suciraṃ śāntaṃ śāntaśca gopikāsutaḥ..49..
1.21.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाद्यैश्च स्तूयमानं परात्परम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा च सुचिरं शान्तं शान्तश्च गोपिकासुतः॥49॥
1.21.m:
being praised by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others, higher than the highest.
Having gazed for a long time upon the serene [Lord], the son of the cowherd woman became serene;

1.21.s:
virarāma ca śokārto yadā taddraṣṭumakṣamaḥ ..
rurodāśvatthamūle ca na dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ śiśuḥ .. 1.21.50 ..
1.21.d:
विरराम च शोकार्तो यदा तद्द्रष्टुमक्षमः ॥
रुरोदाश्वत्थमूले च न दृष्ट्वा बालकं शिशुः ॥ 1.21.50 ॥
1.21.m:
and when he was unable to see him any longer, afflicted with grief, he ceased [his meditation].
Not seeing the boy, the child wept at the root of the peepal tree.

1.21.s:
babhūvākāśavāṇīti rudantaṃ bālakaṃ prati ..
satyaṃ prabodhayuktaṃ ca hitameva mitākṣaram .. 51 ..
1.21.d:
बभूवाकाशवाणीति रुदन्तं बालकं प्रति ॥
सत्यं प्रबोधयुक्तं च हितमेव मिताक्षरम् ॥ 51 ॥
1.21.m:
A voice from the sky spoke to the weeping child,
truthful, full of wisdom, beneficial, and concise:

1.21.s:
sakṛdyaddarśitaṃ rūpaṃ tadeva nādhunā punaḥ ..
api pakvakaṣāyāṇāṃ durdarśaṃ ca kuyoginām .. 52 ..
1.21.d:
सकृद्यद्दर्शितं रूपं तदेव नाधुना पुनः ॥
अपि पक्वकषायाणां दुर्दर्शं च कुयोगिनाम् ॥ 52 ॥
1.21.m:
"That form which was shown once shall not be shown again now;
it is difficult to behold even for those whose impurities are ripened, and for unworthy yogins.

1.21.s:
etasminvigrahe'tīte saṃprāpte divyavigrahe ..
punardrakṣyasi govindaṃ janmamṛtyuharaṃ harim .. 53 ..
1.21.d:
एतस्मिन्विग्रहेऽतीते संप्राप्ते दिव्यविग्रहे ॥
पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि गोविन्दं जन्ममृत्युहरं हरिम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.21.m:
When this body has passed away and a divine body is obtained,
you will behold again Govinda, Hari, the remover of birth and death."

1.21.s:
iti śrutvā bālakaśca virarāma mudā'nvitaḥ ..
kāle tatyāja tīrthe ca tanuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smaran .. 54 ..
1.21.d:
इति श्रुत्वा बालकश्च विरराम मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
काले तत्याज तीर्थे च तनुं कृष्णं हृदि स्मरन् ॥ 54 ॥
1.21.m:
Having heard this, the boy ceased [weeping], filled with joy.
In time, at a sacred ford, he relinquished his body, remembering Kṛṣṇa in his heart.

1.21.s:
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ..
babhūva śāpamuktaśca nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ..55..
1.21.d:
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह ॥
बभूव शापमुक्तश्च नारदश्च महामुनिः॥55॥
1.21.m: and the great sage Nārada became freed from the curse.

1.21.s:
tanuṃ tvakvā sa jīvaśca vilīno brahmavigrahe ..
babhūva prāktanānnityaḥ kālabhede tirohitaḥ .. 56 ..
1.21.d:
तनुं त्वक्वा स जीवश्च विलीनो ब्रह्मविग्रहे ॥
बभूव प्राक्तनान्नित्यः कालभेदे तिरोहितः ॥ 56 ॥
1.21.m:
Abandoning the body, that individual soul merged into the form of Brahman;
he became eternal through past actions, having vanished for a certain time.

1.21.s:
āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ svecchayā nityadehinām ..
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhirbhaktānāṃ nāsti śaunaka .. 57 ..
1.21.d:
आविर्भावस्तिरोभावः स्वेच्छया नित्यदेहिनाम् ॥
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिर्भक्तानां नास्ति शौनक ॥ 57 ॥
1.21.m:
The manifestation and disappearance of eternal souls occurs by their own will;
for devotees, O Śaunaka, there is neither birth, death, old age, nor disease.

1.22.s:
sautiruvāca ..
kati kalpāntare'tīte sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭi vidhau punaḥ ..
marīcimiśraimunibhiḥ sārddhaṃ kaṇṭhādbabhūva saḥ..1..
1.22.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
कति कल्पान्तरेऽतीते स्रष्टुः सृष्टि विधौ पुनः ॥
मरीचिमिश्रैमुनिभिः सार्द्धं कण्ठाद्बभूव सः॥1॥

1.22.s:
vidhernāradanāmnaśca kaṇṭhadeśādbabhūva saḥ ..
nāradaśceti vikhyāto munīndastena hetunā .. 2 ..
1.22.d:
विधेर्नारदनाम्नश्च कण्ठदेशाद्बभूव सः ॥
नारदश्चेति विख्यातो मुनीन्दस्तेन हेतुना ॥ 2 ॥

1.22.s:
yaḥ putraścetaso dhāturbabhūva munipuṃgavaḥ ..
tena pracetā iti ca nāma cakre pitāmahaḥ .. 3 ..
1.22.d:
यः पुत्रश्चेतसो धातुर्बभूव मुनिपुंगवः ॥
तेन प्रचेता इति च नाम चक्रे पितामहः ॥ 3 ॥

1.22.s:
babhūva dhāturyaḥ putraḥ sahasā dakṣapārśvataḥ ..
sarvakarmāṇi dakṣaśca tena dakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 4 ..
1.22.d:
बभूव धातुर्यः पुत्रः सहसा दक्षपार्श्वतः ॥
सर्वकर्माणि दक्षश्च तेन दक्षः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 4 ॥

1.22.s:
vedeṣu kardamaḥ śabdaśchāyāyāṃ varttate sphuṭaḥ ..
babhūva kardamādvālaḥ kardamastena kīrttitaḥ .. 5 ..
1.22.d:
वेदेषु कर्दमः शब्दश्छायायां वर्त्तते स्फुटः ॥
बभूव कर्दमाद्वालः कर्दमस्तेन कीर्त्तितः ॥ 5 ॥

1.22.s:
tejobhede marīciśca vedeṣu varttate sphuṭam ..
jātaḥ sadyo'titejasvī marīcistena kīrtitaḥ .. 6 ..
1.22.d:
तेजोभेदे मरीचिश्च वेदेषु वर्त्तते स्फुटम् ॥
जातः सद्योऽतितेजस्वी मरीचिस्तेन कीर्तितः ॥ 6 ॥

1.22.s:
kratusaṃghaśca bālena kṛto janmāntare'dhunā ..
brahmaputre'pi tannāma kraturityabhidhīyate .. 7 ..
1.22.d:
क्रतुसंघश्च बालेन कृतो जन्मान्तरेऽधुना ॥
ब्रह्मपुत्रेऽपि तन्नाम क्रतुरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 7 ॥

1.22.s:
pradhānāṅgamukhaṃ dhātustato jātaśca bālakaḥ ..
irastejasvivacano'pyaṅgirāstena kīrttitaḥ .. 8 ..
1.22.d:
प्रधानाङ्गमुखं धातुस्ततो जातश्च बालकः ॥
इरस्तेजस्विवचनोऽप्यङ्गिरास्तेन कीर्त्तितः ॥ 8 ॥

1.22.s:
atitejasvini bhṛgurvarttate nāgni śaunaka ..
jātaḥ sadyo'titejasvī bhṛgustena prakīrttitaḥ .. 9 ..
1.22.d:
अतितेजस्विनि भृगुर्वर्त्तते नाग्नि शौनक ॥
जातः सद्योऽतितेजस्वी भृगुस्तेन प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 9 ॥

1.22.s:
bālo'pyaruṇavarṇaśca jātaḥ sadyo'titejasā ..
prajvalannūrdhvatapasā cāruṇistena kīrttitaḥ.. 1.22.10 ..
1.22.d:
बालोऽप्यरुणवर्णश्च जातः सद्योऽतितेजसा ॥
प्रज्वलन्नूर्ध्वतपसा चारुणिस्तेन कीर्त्तितः॥ 1.22.10 ॥

1.22.s:
haṃsā ātmavaśā yasya yogena yogino dhuvam ..
bālaḥ paramayogīndrastena haṃsī prakīrttitaḥ .. 11 ..
1.22.d:
हंसा आत्मवशा यस्य योगेन योगिनो धुवम् ॥
बालः परमयोगीन्द्रस्तेन हंसी प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 11 ॥

1.22.s:
vaśībhūtaśca śiṣyaśca jātaḥ sadyo hi bālakaḥ ..
atipriyaśca dhātuśca vaśiṣṭhastena kīrttitaḥ .. 12 ..
1.22.d:
वशीभूतश्च शिष्यश्च जातः सद्यो हि बालकः ॥
अतिप्रियश्च धातुश्च वशिष्ठस्तेन कीर्त्तितः ॥ 12 ॥

1.22.s:
santataṃ yasya yatnaṃ ca tapaḥsu bālakasya ca ..
prakīrttito yatistena saṃyataḥ sarvakarmasu ..
pulastapaḥsu vedeṣu varttate'haḥ sphuṭe'pi ca .. 13 ..
1.22.d:
सन्ततं यस्य यत्नं च तपःसु बालकस्य च ॥
प्रकीर्त्तितो यतिस्तेन संयतः सर्वकर्मसु ॥
पुलस्तपःसु वेदेषु वर्त्ततेऽहः स्फुटेऽपि च ॥ 13 ॥

1.22.s:
sphuṭastapaḥsamūhaśca pulahastena bālakaḥ ..
pulastapaḥ samūhaśca yasyāsti pūrvajanmanām ..
tapaḥsaṃghasvarūpaśca pulastyastena bālakaḥ .. 14 ..
1.22.d:
स्फुटस्तपःसमूहश्च पुलहस्तेन बालकः ॥
पुलस्तपः समूहश्च यस्यास्ति पूर्वजन्मनाम् ॥
तपःसंघस्वरूपश्च पुलस्त्यस्तेन बालकः ॥ 14 ॥

1.22.s:
triguṇāyāṃ prakṛtyāṃ trirviṣṇāvaśca pravarttate ..
tayobhaktiḥ samā yasya tena bālo'trirucyate .. 15 .. atri śabdopari ṭippaṇī
1.22.d:
त्रिगुणायां प्रकृत्यां त्रिर्विष्णावश्च प्रवर्त्तते ॥
तयोभक्तिः समा यस्य तेन बालोऽत्रिरुच्यते ॥ 15 ॥ अत्रि शब्दोपरि टिप्पणी
1.22.m:
Tri denotes the threefold nature of Prakṛti, and a denotes Viṣṇu.
He who possesses equal devotion to both is therefore called the boy Atri. / On his head are five matted locks having the form of flames of fire;

1.22.s:
jaṭā vahniśikhārūpāḥ pañca santi ca mastake ..
tapastejobhavā yasya sa ca pañcaśikhaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 16 ..
1.22.d:
जटा वह्निशिखारूपाः पञ्च सन्ति च मस्तके ॥
तपस्तेजोभवा यस्य स च पञ्चशिखः स्मृतः ॥ 16 ॥
1.22.m: born of the splendour of his austerities, he is traditionally remembered as Pañcaśikha.

1.22.s:
apāntaratame deśe tapastepe'nyajanmani ..
apāntaratamā nāma śiśostena prakīrtitam .. 17 ..
1.22.d:
अपान्तरतमे देशे तपस्तेपेऽन्यजन्मनि ॥
अपान्तरतमा नाम शिशोस्तेन प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.22.m:
In another birth, he practiced austerity in the most remote region (apāntaratama);
therefore, the name Apāntaratamas was proclaimed for that child.

1.22.s:
svayaṃ tapaḥ samāpnoti vāhayetprāpayetparān ..
voḍhuṃ samarthastapasi voḍhustena prakīrtitaḥ ..18..
1.22.d:
स्वयं तपः समाप्नोति वाहयेत्प्रापयेत्परान् ॥
वोढुं समर्थस्तपसि वोढुस्तेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥18॥
1.22.m:
He accomplishes austerity himself, and causes others to bear and attain it;
being capable of bearing (voḍhum) austerity, he is therefore proclaimed Voḍhu.

1.22.s:
tapasastejasā bālo dīptimānsatataṃ mune ..
tapaḥsu rocate cittaṃ rucistena prakīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
1.22.d:
तपसस्तेजसा बालो दीप्तिमान्सततं मुने ॥
तपःसु रोचते चित्तं रुचिस्तेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 19 ॥
1.22.m:
O sage, through the brilliance of his austerity, the boy was constantly radiant (dīptimān);
his mind delighted (rocate) in austerities, and therefore he is proclaimed Ruci.

1.22.s:
kopakāle babhūvurye sraṣṭurekādaśa smṛtāḥ ..
rodanādeva rudrāśca kopitāstena hetunā..1.22.20..
1.22.d:
कोपकाले बभूवुर्ये स्रष्टुरेकादश स्मृताः ॥
रोदनादेव रुद्राश्च कोपितास्तेन हेतुना॥1.22.20॥
1.22.m:
Those who came into being at the time of the Creator's anger are remembered as eleven.
From their weeping (rodana) they are the Rudras, and for that reason they were enraged.

1.22.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
rudreṣvekatamo bālo maheśa iti me bhramaḥ ..
bhavānpurāṇatattvajñaḥ sandehaṃ chettumarhati..21..
1.22.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
रुद्रेष्वेकतमो बालो महेश इति मे भ्रमः ॥
भवान्पुराणतत्त्वज्ञः सन्देहं छेत्तुमर्हति॥21॥
1.22.m:
"I have a delusion that Maheśa is one of the children among the Rudras.
You know the true essence of the Purāṇas; you ought to sever my doubt."

1.22.s:
sautiruvāca ..
viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇaḥ pātā brahmā sraṣṭā rajoguṇaḥ..
tamoguṇāste rudrāśca durnivārā bhayaṃkarāḥ .. 22 ..
1.22.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
विष्णुः सत्त्वगुणः पाता ब्रह्मा स्रष्टा रजोगुणः॥
तमोगुणास्ते रुद्राश्च दुर्निवारा भयंकराः ॥ 22 ॥
1.22.m:
"Viṣṇu, endowed with sattvaguṇa, is the protector; Brahmā, endowed with rajoguṇa, is the creator;
and those Rudras are endowed with tamoguṇa, irrepressible and terrifying.

1.22.s:
kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā teṣvekaḥ śaṃkarāṃśakaḥ ..
śuddhasattvasvarūpaśca śivaśca śivadaḥ satām .. 23 ..
1.22.d:
कालाग्निरुद्रः संहर्त्ता तेष्वेकः शंकरांशकः ॥
शुद्धसत्त्वस्वरूपश्च शिवश्च शिवदः सताम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.22.m:
Kālāgnirudra is the destroyer, one among them, a portion of Śaṅkara.
Śiva's essential nature is pure sattva, and he bestows auspiciousness upon the virtuous.

1.22.s:
anye kṛṣṇasya ca kalāstāvaṃśau viṣṇuśaṃkarau ..
samau sattvasvarūpau dvau paripūrṇatamasya ca .. 24 ..
1.22.d:
अन्ये कृष्णस्य च कलास्तावंशौ विष्णुशंकरौ ॥
समौ सत्त्वस्वरूपौ द्वौ परिपूर्णतमस्य च ॥ 24 ॥
1.22.m:
The others are parts of Kṛṣṇa, whereas those two—Viṣṇu and Śaṅkara—are his portions.
Both are equal, having the nature of sattva, of the most completely full [Lord].

1.22.s:
uktaṃ rudrodbhave kāle kathaṃ vismarati dvija ..
māyayā mohitāḥ sarve munīnāṃ ca matibhramaḥ .. 25 ..
1.22.d:
उक्तं रुद्रोद्भवे काले कथं विस्मरति द्विज ॥
मायया मोहिताः सर्वे मुनीनां च मतिभ्रमः ॥ 25 ॥
1.22.m:
This was stated at the time of the origin of the Rudras; how do you forget it, O twice-born?
All are deluded by Māyā, and even sages suffer delusion of mind.

1.22.s:
sanakaśca sanaṃdaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sanatkumāro bhagavāṃścaturtho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ .. 26 ..
1.22.d:
सनकश्च सनंदश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः ॥
सनत्कुमारो भगवांश्चतुर्थो ब्रह्मणः सुतः ॥ 26 ॥
1.22.m:
Sanaka, Sananda, and the third, Sanātana,
and the venerable Sanatkumāra was the fourth son of Brahmā.

1.22.s:
brahmā sraṣṭuṃ pūrvaputrānuvāca te na sehire ..
tena prakopito dhātā rudrāḥ kopodbhavā mune .. 2 ..
1.22.d:
ब्रह्मा स्रष्टुं पूर्वपुत्रानुवाच ते न सेहिरे ॥
तेन प्रकोपितो धाता रुद्राः कोपोद्भवा मुने ॥ 2 ॥
1.22.m:
Brahmā told his elder sons to create, but they refused to submit.
The Creator was angered by that, O sage; the Rudras were born from his anger.

1.22.s:
sanakaśca sanandaśca tau dvāvānandavācakau ..
ānanditau ca bālau dvau bhaktipūrṇatamau sadā .. 28 ..
1.22.d:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तौ द्वावानन्दवाचकौ ॥
आनन्दितौ च बालौ द्वौ भक्तिपूर्णतमौ सदा ॥ 28 ॥
1.22.m:
Sanaka and Sananda—both words signify bliss (ānanda);
and both boys were blissful, always overflowing with devotion.

1.22.s:
sanātanaśca śrīkṛṣṇo nityaḥ pūrṇatamaḥ svayam ..
tadbhaktastatsamaḥ satyaṃ tena bālaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 29 ..
1.22.d:
सनातनश्च श्रीकृष्णो नित्यः पूर्णतमः स्वयम् ॥
तद्भक्तस्तत्समः सत्यं तेन बालः सनातनः ॥ 29 ॥
1.22.m:
And Śrī Kṛṣṇa is Sanātana—eternal, the most completely full Himself.
Truly, his devotee is equal to him; therefore that boy is Sanātana.

1.22.s:
sanattu nityavacanaḥ kumāraḥ śiśuvācakaḥ ..
sanatkumāraṃ tenemamuvāca kamalodbhavaḥ .. 1.22.30 ..
1.22.d:
सनत्तु नित्यवचनः कुमारः शिशुवाचकः ॥
सनत्कुमारं तेनेममुवाच कमलोद्भवः ॥ 1.22.30 ॥
1.22.m:
Sanat expresses 'eternal', and kumāra expresses 'child'.
Therefore, the lotus-born [Brahmā] called him Sanatkumāra.

1.22.s:
brahmaṇo bālakānāṃ ca vyutpattiḥ kathitā mune ..
sāmprataṃ nāradākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ ca yathākramam.. 31 ..
1.22.d:
ब्रह्मणो बालकानां च व्युत्पत्तिः कथिता मुने ॥
साम्प्रतं नारदाख्यानं श्रूयतां च यथाक्रमम्॥ 31 ॥
1.22.m:
O sage, the etymology of Brahmā's sons has been told.
Now hear the account of Nārada in proper sequence. // 31

1.23.s:
sautiruvāca ..
sraṣṭā sṛṣṭividhānena niyojya sarvabālakān ..
nāradaṃ prerayāmāsa sṛṣṭiṃ karttuṃ ca śaunaka .. 1 ..
1.23.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
स्रष्टा सृष्टिविधानेन नियोज्य सर्वबालकान् ॥
नारदं प्रेरयामास सृष्टिं कर्त्तुं च शौनक ॥ 1 ॥

1.23.s:
hitaṃ satyaṃ vedasāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ..
uvāca nāradaṃ brahmā vedavedāṅgapāragam .. 2 ..
1.23.d:
हितं सत्यं वेदसारं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥
उवाच नारदं ब्रह्मा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगम् ॥ 2 ॥

1.23.s:
brahmovāca ..
ehi vatsa kulaśreṣṭha nārada prāṇavallabha ..
jñānadīpaśikhājñānatimirakṣayakāraka .. 3 ..
1.23.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
एहि वत्स कुलश्रेष्ठ नारद प्राणवल्लभ ॥
ज्ञानदीपशिखाज्ञानतिमिरक्षयकारक ॥ 3 ॥

1.23.s:
pūrveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ janakaḥ paramo guruḥ ..
vidyādātā mantradātā dvau samau ca pituḥ parau .. 4 ..
1.23.d:
पूर्वेषामपि वन्द्यानां जनकः परमो गुरुः ॥
विद्यादाता मन्त्रदाता द्वौ समौ च पितुः परौ ॥ 4 ॥

1.23.s:
tavāhaṃ janakaḥ putra vidyādātā ca pālakaḥ ..
mamājñayā ca matprītyā kuru dāraparigraham .. 5 ..
1.23.d:
तवाहं जनकः पुत्र विद्यादाता च पालकः ॥
ममाज्ञया च मत्प्रीत्या कुरु दारपरिग्रहम् ॥ 5 ॥

1.23.s:
sa ca śiṣyaḥ so'pi putro yaścājñāṃ pālayedguroḥ ..
na kṣemaṃ tasya mūḍhasya yo guroravacaskaraḥ .. 6 ..
1.23.d:
स च शिष्यः सोऽपि पुत्रो यश्चाज्ञां पालयेद्गुरोः ॥
न क्षेमं तस्य मूढस्य यो गुरोरवचस्करः ॥ 6 ॥

1.23.s:
sa paṇḍitaḥ sa ca jñānī sa kṣemī sa ca puṇyavān ..
gurovarcaskaro yo hi kṣemaṃ tasya pade pade .. .. 7 ..
1.23.d:
स पण्डितः स च ज्ञानी स क्षेमी स च पुण्यवान् ॥
गुरोवर्चस्करो यो हि क्षेमं तस्य पदे पदे ॥ ॥ 7 ॥

1.23.s:
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca pradhānaḥ puṇyavāngṛhī..
strīputrapautrayuktaṃ ca mandiraṃ tapasaḥ phalam .. 8 ..
1.23.d:
सर्वेषामाश्रमाणां च प्रधानः पुण्यवान्गृही॥
स्त्रीपुत्रपौत्रयुक्तं च मन्दिरं तपसः फलम् ॥ 8 ॥

1.23.s:
pitaraḥ pūrvakāle ca tithikāle ca devatāḥ ..
sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ .. 9 ..
1.23.d:
पितरः पूर्वकाले च तिथिकाले च देवताः ॥
सर्वे गृहस्थमायान्ति निपानमिव धेनवः ॥ 9 ॥

1.23.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kurvanti gṛhiṇaḥ sadā ..
iha etatsukhaṃ puṇyaṃ svargabhogaḥ paratra ca .. 1.23.10 ..
1.23.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं कुर्वन्ति गृहिणः सदा ॥
इह एतत्सुखं पुण्यं स्वर्गभोगः परत्र च ॥ 1.23.10 ॥

1.23.s:
jīvanmukto gṛhasthaśca svadharmaparipālakaḥ ..
yaśasvī puṇyavāṃścaiva kīrtimāndhanavānsukhī.. 11 ..
1.23.d:
जीवन्मुक्तो गृहस्थश्च स्वधर्मपरिपालकः ॥
यशस्वी पुण्यवांश्चैव कीर्तिमान्धनवान्सुखी॥ 11 ॥

1.23.s:
yaśasvī kīrtimānyo hi mṛto jīvati santatam ..
yaśaḥkīrtivihīno hi jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ..12..
1.23.d:
यशस्वी कीर्तिमान्यो हि मृतो जीवति सन्ततम् ॥
यशःकीर्तिविहीनो हि जीवन्नपि मृतो हि सः ॥12॥

1.23.s:
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ ..
uvāca vinayaṃ bhītaḥ śuṣkaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ..13..
1.23.d:
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ॥
उवाच विनयं भीतः शुष्कण्ठौष्ठतालुकः॥13॥

1.23.s:
nārada uvāca..
ekadā vāgvirodhena cobhayostātaputrayoḥ ..
hānirbabhūva daivena mahatī vā'yaśaskarī .. 14 ..
1.23.d:
नारद उवाच॥
एकदा वाग्विरोधेन चोभयोस्तातपुत्रयोः ॥
हानिर्बभूव दैवेन महती वाऽयशस्करी ॥ 14 ॥

1.23.s:
mayā prāptaṃ ca tvacchāpādgāndharvaṃ śaudrameva ca ..
janma karma ca macchāpāttvamapūjyo bhave bhava .. 15 ..
1.23.d:
मया प्राप्तं च त्वच्छापाद्गान्धर्वं शौद्रमेव च ॥
जन्म कर्म च मच्छापात्त्वमपूज्यो भवे भव ॥ 15 ॥

1.23.s:
babhūva śāpo mukto me kāle te bhavitā vidhe ..
doṣāya kalpate śaśvadvirodho na guṇāya ca .. 16 ..
1.23.d:
बभूव शापो मुक्तो मे काले ते भविता विधे ॥
दोषाय कल्पते शश्वद्विरोधो न गुणाय च ॥ 16 ॥

1.23.s:
sa pitā sa gururbandhuḥ sa putraḥ samadhīśvaraḥ ..
yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādapadme dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ ca kārayet ..17..
1.23.d:
स पिता स गुरुर्बन्धुः स पुत्रः समधीश्वरः ॥
यः श्रीकृष्णपादपद्मे दृढां भक्तिं च कारयेत् ॥17॥

1.23.s:
asadvartmani cājñānādgacchanti yadi bālakāḥ ..
nivarttayati tāneva sa pitā karuṇānidhiḥ .. 18 ..
1.23.d:
असद्वर्त्मनि चाज्ञानाद्गच्छन्ति यदि बालकाः ॥
निवर्त्तयति तानेव स पिता करुणानिधिः ॥ 18 ॥

1.23.s:
kārayitvā kṛṣṇapāde bhaktityāgaṃ ca yaḥ pitā ..
anyasminviṣaye putraṃ sa kiṃ hantuṃ pravarttayet .. 19 ..
1.23.d:
कारयित्वा कृष्णपादे भक्तित्यागं च यः पिता ॥
अन्यस्मिन्विषये पुत्रं स किं हन्तुं प्रवर्त्तयेत् ॥ 19 ॥

1.23.s:
dāragraho hi duḥkhāya kevalaṃ na sukhāya ca ..
tapaḥsvargabhaktimuktikarmaṇāṃ vyavadhāyakaḥ .. 1.23.20 ..
1.23.d:
दारग्रहो हि दुःखाय केवलं न सुखाय च ॥
तपःस्वर्गभक्तिमुक्तिकर्मणां व्यवधायकः ॥ 1.23.20 ॥

1.23.s:
yoṣitastrividhā brahmangṛhiṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām ..
sādhvī bhogyā ca kulaṭāstāḥ sarvāḥ svārthatatparāḥ..21..
1.23.d:
योषितस्त्रिविधा ब्रह्मन्गृहिणां मूढचेतसाम् ॥
साध्वी भोग्या च कुलटास्ताः सर्वाः स्वार्थतत्पराः॥21॥

1.23.s:
paralokabhiyā sādhvī tatheha yaśasā''tmanaḥ ..
kāmasnehācca kurute bhartuḥ sevāṃ ca santatam .. 22 ..
1.23.d:
परलोकभिया साध्वी तथेह यशसा'ऽत्मनः ॥
कामस्नेहाच्च कुरुते भर्तुः सेवां च सन्ततम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.23.m:
From fear of the other world, and likewise for her own renown in this world,
and out of passionate affection, the virtuous wife constantly serves her husband. // 22

1.23.s:
bhogyā bhogārthinī śaśvatkāmasnehena kevalam ..
kurute kāntasevā ca na ca bhogādṛte kṣaṇam .. 23 ..
1.23.d:
भोग्या भोगार्थिनी शश्वत्कामस्नेहेन केवलम् ॥
कुरुते कान्तसेवा च न च भोगादृते क्षणम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.23.m:
The woman for enjoyment is constantly desirous of pleasure solely through lust and affection;
she serves her lover, yet not for a moment without enjoyment. // 23

1.23.s:
vastrālaṃkārasambhogasusnigdhāhāramuttamam ..
yāvatprāpnoti sā bhogyā tāvacca vaśagā priyā .. 24 ..
1.23.d:
वस्त्रालंकारसम्भोगसुस्निग्धाहारमुत्तमम् ॥
यावत्प्राप्नोति सा भोग्या तावच्च वशगा प्रिया ॥ 24 ॥
1.23.m:
As long as she receives clothes, ornaments, sexual pleasure, and very rich, excellent food,
so long does that beloved remain submissive. // 24

1.23.s:
kulāṅgārasamā nārī kulaṭā kulanāśinī ..
kapaṭātkurute sevāṃ svāmino na ca bhaktitaḥ .. 25 ..
1.23.d:
कुलाङ्गारसमा नारी कुलटा कुलनाशिनी ॥
कपटात्कुरुते सेवां स्वामिनो न च भक्तितः ॥ 25 ॥
1.23.m:
A woman who is like a charcoal to her family is unchaste and ruins her lineage;
she serves her husband out of deceit, and not out of devotion. // 25

1.23.s:
sadā puṃyogamāśaṃsurmanasā madanāturā..
āhārādadhikaṃ jāraṃ prārthayantī navaṃ navam .. 26 ..
1.23.d:
सदा पुंयोगमाशंसुर्मनसा मदनातुरा॥
आहारादधिकं जारं प्रार्थयन्ती नवं नवम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.23.m:
Always yearning in her mind for union with men, tormented by passion,
desiring a paramour more than food, constantly seeking someone new, // 26

1.23.s:
jārārthe svapatiṃ tāta hantumicchati puṃścalī ..
tasyāṃ yo viśvasenmūḍho jīvanaṃ tasya niṣphalam .. 27 ..
1.23.d:
जारार्थे स्वपतिं तात हन्तुमिच्छति पुंश्चली ॥
तस्यां यो विश्वसेन्मूढो जीवनं तस्य निष्फलम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.23.m:
for the sake of her paramour, O father, an unchaste woman even wishes to kill her own husband.
The fool who trusts in her—his life is in vain.

1.23.s:
kathitā yoṣitaḥ sarvā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ ..
svātmārāmā vijānanti manastāsāṃ na paṇḍitāḥ .. 28 ..
1.23.d:
कथिता योषितः सर्वा उत्तमाधममध्यमाः ॥
स्वात्मारामा विजानन्ति मनस्तासां न पण्डिताः ॥ 28 ॥
1.23.m:
All women have been described: the highest, lowest, and middling.
Even those who take delight in the self, the learned, do not understand their minds.

1.23.s:
hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ śaratpadmotsavaṃ mukham ..
sudhāsamaṃ sumadhuraṃ vacanaṃ svārthasiddhaye .. 29 ..
1.23.d:
हृदयं क्षुरधाराभं शरत्पद्मोत्सवं मुखम् ॥
सुधासमं सुमधुरं वचनं स्वार्थसिद्धये ॥ 29 ॥
1.23.m:
Their heart is like a razor's edge, their face like an autumn lotus festival,
and their words, to accomplish their selfish aims, are like nectar, exceedingly sweet;

1.23.s:
prakope viṣatulyaṃ ca viśvāse sarvanāśanam ..
durjñeyaṃ tadabhiprāyaṃ nigūḍhaṃ karma kevalam .. 1.23.30 ..
1.23.d:
प्रकोपे विषतुल्यं च विश्वासे सर्वनाशनम् ॥
दुर्ज्ञेयं तदभिप्रायं निगूढं कर्म केवलम् ॥ 1.23.30 ॥
1.23.m:
yet in anger they are like poison, and in trusting them lies total ruin.
Their intention is difficult to know, and their conduct is entirely concealed.

1.23.s:
sadā tāsāmavinayaḥ prabalaṃ sāhasaṃ param ..
doṣotkarṣaśchalotkarṣaḥ śaśvanmāyā duratyayā .. 31 ..
1.23.d:
सदा तासामविनयः प्रबलं साहसं परम् ॥
दोषोत्कर्षश्छलोत्कर्षः शश्वन्माया दुरत्यया ॥ 31 ॥
1.23.m:
With them, there is always impudence and extreme, reckless daring;
faults abound, deceit abounds, and their illusion is ever insurmountable.

1.23.s:
puṃsaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ kāmaḥ śaśvatkāmo jagadguro ..
āhāro dviguṇo nityaṃ naiṣṭhuryyaṃ ca caturguṇam ..32..
1.23.d:
पुंसश्चाष्टगुणः कामः शश्वत्कामो जगद्गुरो ॥
आहारो द्विगुणो नित्यं नैष्ठुर्य्यं च चतुर्गुणम् ॥32॥
1.23.m:
O Teacher of the universe, their desire is eightfold that of a man, their passion perpetual;
their hunger is always twofold, and their cruelty fourfold;

1.23.s:
kopaḥ puṃsaḥ ṣaḍguṇaśca vyavasāyaśca niścitam..
yatreme doṣanivahāḥ kā''sthā tatra pitāmaha..33..
1.23.d:
कोपः पुंसः षड्गुणश्च व्यवसायश्च निश्चितम्॥
यत्रेमे दोषनिवहाः का'ऽस्था तत्र पितामह॥33॥
1.23.m:
their anger is sixfold that of a man, as is their determination, surely.
Where these multitude of faults dwell, what trust can there be, O Grandfather?

1.23.s:
kā krīḍā kiṃ sukhaṃ puṃso viṇmūtramalaveśmani..
tejaḥ pranaṣṭaṃ sambhoge divālāpe yaśaḥkṣayaḥ .. 34 ..
1.23.d:
का क्रीडा किं सुखं पुंसो विण्मूत्रमलवेश्मनि॥
तेजः प्रनष्टं सम्भोगे दिवालापे यशःक्षयः ॥ 34 ॥
1.23.m:
What sport, what happiness is there for a man in that dwelling of feces, urine, and filth?
Vitality is lost in sexual union, and renown is destroyed in daytime chatter.

1.23.s:
dhanakṣayo'tiprītau cātyāsaktau ca vapuḥkṣayaḥ..
sāhitye pauruṣaṃ naṣṭaṃ kalahe mānanāśanam ..
sarvanāśaśca viśvāse brahmannārīṣu kiṃ sukham .. 35 ..
1.23.d:
धनक्षयोऽतिप्रीतौ चात्यासक्तौ च वपुःक्षयः॥
साहित्ये पौरुषं नष्टं कलहे माननाशनम् ॥
सर्वनाशश्च विश्वासे ब्रह्मन्नारीषु किं सुखम् ॥ 35 ॥

1.23.s:
yāvaddhanī ca tejasvī saśrīko yogyatāparaḥ ..
pumānnārīṃ vaśīkartuṃ samarthastāvadeva hi .. 36 ..
1.23.d:
यावद्धनी च तेजस्वी सश्रीको योग्यतापरः ॥
पुमान्नारीं वशीकर्तुं समर्थस्तावदेव हि ॥ 36 ॥
1.23.m:
Only so long as he is wealthy, radiant, prosperous, and devoted to capability,
is a man truly able to hold a woman under his control.

1.23.s:
rogiṇaṃ nirddhanaṃ vṛddhaṃ yoṣidvai prekṣate'priyam ..
lokācārabhayāttasmai dadātyāhāramalpakam .. 37 ..
1.23.d:
रोगिणं निर्द्धनं वृद्धं योषिद्वै प्रेक्षतेऽप्रियम् ॥
लोकाचारभयात्तस्मै ददात्याहारमल्पकम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.23.m:
A woman looks upon a diseased, penniless, or old man as unpleasant;
only out of fear of worldly custom does she give him a little food.

1.23.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmannātmāgamo yathā ..
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña svātmārāmeśvaro bhavān .. 38 ..
1.23.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं ब्रह्मन्नात्मागमो यथा ॥
सर्वं जानासि सर्वज्ञ स्वात्मारामेश्वरो भवान् ॥ 38 ॥
1.23.m:
All this has thus been spoken, O Brahman, according to my own understanding.
You know everything, O omniscient one; you are the master of those who delight in the self.

1.23.s:
anugrahaṃ kuru vibho vidāyaṃ dehi sāmpratam ..
kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prārthayāmi tvayi kalpataroḥ pare .. 39 ..
1.23.d:
अनुग्रहं कुरु विभो विदायं देहि साम्प्रतम् ॥
कृष्णभक्तिं प्रार्थयामि त्वयि कल्पतरोः परे ॥ 39 ॥
1.23.m:
Grant your favour, O Lord; give me leave now.
I beg for devotion to Kṛṣṇa from you, who are greater than a wish-fulfilling tree."

1.23.s:
ityuktvā nāradastatra dhṛtvā tātapadāmbujam ..
ājñāṃ yayāce pitaraṃ gantu tapasi maṅgale .. 1.23.40 ..
1.23.d:
इत्युक्त्वा नारदस्तत्र धृत्वा तातपदाम्बुजम् ॥
आज्ञां ययाचे पितरं गन्तु तपसि मङ्गले ॥ 1.23.40 ॥
1.23.m:
Having spoken thus, Nārada grasped his father's lotus feet there
and begged permission from his father to depart for auspicious austerity.

1.23.s:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ..
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ natvā brahmāṇaṃ gantumudyataḥ .. 41 ..
1.23.d:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः॥
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं नत्वा ब्रह्माणं गन्तुमुद्यतः ॥ 41 ॥
1.23.m:
Folding his hands in reverence, bowing his neck in devotion,
and circumambulating and bowing to Brahmā, he prepared to leave.

1.23.s:
gacchantaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune ..
rurodoccairmuktakaṇṭhaṃ mahāsāṃsāriko yathā .. 42 ..
1.23.d:
गच्छन्तं तनयं दृष्ट्वा विधाता जगतां मुने ॥
रुरोदोच्चैर्मुक्तकण्ठं महासांसारिको यथा ॥ 42 ॥
1.23.m:
Seeing his son departing, O sage, the Creator of the worlds
wept loudly and unconstrainedly, like an ordinary worldly man.

1.23.s:
kare dhṛtvā samāliṅgya cucumba ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
ciraṃ vakṣasi kṛtvā ca vāsayāmāsa jānuni .. 43 ..
1.23.d:
करे धृत्वा समालिङ्ग्य चुचुम्ब च पुनः पुनः ॥
चिरं वक्षसि कृत्वा च वासयामास जानुनि ॥ 43 ॥
1.23.m:
Taking him by the hand, embracing him, he kissed him again and again,
held him to his chest for a long time, and seated him on his lap.

1.23.s:
svātmārāmeśvaro brahmā yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ..
bheda soḍhuṃ na śakto'bhūdvicchedo duḥsaho nṛṇām .. 44 ..
1.23.d:
स्वात्मारामेश्वरो ब्रह्मा योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥
भेद सोढुं न शक्तोऽभूद्विच्छेदो दुःसहो नृणाम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.23.m:
Brahmā, master of those who delight in the self, the teacher of the teachers of supreme yogins,
was unable to endure the separation; separation from loved ones is unbearable for men.

1.23.s:
kātaraḥ putrabhedena mohito viṣcumāyayā..
śokārtto vaktumārebhe sutaṃ sambodhya śaunaka .. 45 ..
1.23.d:
कातरः पुत्रभेदेन मोहितो विष्चुमायया॥
शोकार्त्तो वक्तुमारेभे सुतं सम्बोध्य शौनक ॥ 45 ॥
1.23.m:
Distressed by separation from his son, deluded by Viṣṇu's māyā,
afflicted with grief, he began to speak, addressing his son, O Śaunaka.

1.24.s:
śrībrahmovāca ..
tvaṃ gaccha tapase vatsa kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi ..
ahaṃ yāsyāmi golokaṃ vijñātuṃ kṛṣṇamīśvaram .. 1 ..
1.24.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच ॥
त्वं गच्छ तपसे वत्स किं मे संसारकर्मणि ॥
अहं यास्यामि गोलोकं विज्ञातुं कृष्णमीश्वरम् ॥ 1 ॥

1.24.s:
sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sanatkumāro nīrāgaścaturthaḥ putra eva ca .. 2 ..
1.24.d:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः ॥
सनत्कुमारो नीरागश्चतुर्थः पुत्र एव च ॥ 2 ॥

1.24.s:
yatī haṃsī cāruṇiśca voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ..
putrāstapasvinaḥ sarve kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi .. 3 ..
1.24.d:
यती हंसी चारुणिश्च वोढुः पञ्चशिखस्तथा ॥
पुत्रास्तपस्विनः सर्वे किं मे संसारकर्मणि ॥ 3 ॥

1.24.s:
vacaskaro marīcirme aṅgirāśca bhṛgustathā ..
ruciratriḥ kardamaśca pracetāśca kraturmanuḥ .. 4 ..
1.24.d:
वचस्करो मरीचिर्मे अङ्गिराश्च भृगुस्तथा ॥
रुचिरत्रिः कर्दमश्च प्रचेताश्च क्रतुर्मनुः ॥ 4 ॥

1.24.s:
vasiṣṭho vaśagaḥ śaśvatsarveṣu ca suteṣu ca ..
anye 'vivekino'sādhyāḥ kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi .. 5 ..
1.24.d:
वसिष्ठो वशगः शश्वत्सर्वेषु च सुतेषु च ॥
अन्ये ऽविवेकिनोऽसाध्याः किं मे संसारकर्मणि ॥ 5 ॥

1.24.s:
nibodha vatsa vakṣyāmi vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ śubham ..
pāramparyyakramaparaṃ caturvargaphalapradam .. .. 6 ..
1.24.d:
निबोध वत्स वक्ष्यामि वेदोक्तं वचनं शुभम् ॥
पारम्पर्य्यक्रमपरं चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदम् ॥ ॥ 6 ॥

1.24.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sarve vāñchanti paṇḍitāḥ ..
vedapraṇihitānetānsabhāsu muniśaṃsitān .. 7 ..
1.24.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षांश्च सर्वे वाञ्छन्ति पण्डिताः ॥
वेदप्रणिहितानेतान्सभासु मुनिशंसितान् ॥ 7 ॥

1.24.s:
vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyyayaḥ ..
ādau vipro yajñasūtraṃ paridhāya sukhaṃ sukhī .. 8 ..
1.24.d:
वेदप्रणिहितो धर्मो ह्यधर्मस्तद्विपर्य्ययः ॥
आदौ विप्रो यज्ञसूत्रं परिधाय सुखं सुखी ॥ 8 ॥

1.24.s:
samadhītya tato vedāndadāti gurudakṣiṇām ..
tataḥ prakṛṣṭakulajāṃ suvinītāṃ samudvahet .. 9 ..
1.24.d:
समधीत्य ततो वेदान्ददाति गुरुदक्षिणाम् ॥
ततः प्रकृष्टकुलजां सुविनीतां समुद्वहेत् ॥ 9 ॥

1.24.s:
sā sādhvī kulajā yā ca patisevāsu tatparā ..
sadvaro durvinītā ca saṃbhavenna kadācana ..
ākare padmarāgāṇāṃ janma kācamaṇeḥ kutaḥ .. 1.24.10 ..
1.24.d:
सा साध्वी कुलजा या च पतिसेवासु तत्परा ॥
सद्वरो दुर्विनीता च संभवेन्न कदाचन ॥
आकरे पद्मरागाणां जन्म काचमणेः कुतः ॥ 1.24.10 ॥

1.24.s:
asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā pitrordoṣeṇa nārada ..
durvinītā ca sā duṣṭā svatantrā sarvakarmasu .. 11 ..
1.24.d:
असद्वंशप्रसूता या पित्रोर्दोषेण नारद ॥
दुर्विनीता च सा दुष्टा स्वतन्त्रा सर्वकर्मसु ॥ 11 ॥

1.24.s:
na vatsa duṣṭāḥ sarvāśca yoṣitaḥ kamalākalāḥ ..
svarveśyāṃśāśca kulaṭā asadvaṃśa samudbhavāḥ .. 12 ..
1.24.d:
न वत्स दुष्टाः सर्वाश्च योषितः कमलाकलाः ॥
स्वर्वेश्यांशाश्च कुलटा असद्वंश समुद्भवाः ॥ 12 ॥

1.24.s:
nirguṇaṃ svāminaṃ sādhvī sevate ca praśaṃsati ..
na sevate ca kulaṭā priyaṃ nindati sadguṇam .. 13 ..
1.24.d:
निर्गुणं स्वामिनं साध्वी सेवते च प्रशंसति ॥
न सेवते च कुलटा प्रियं निन्दति सद्गुणम् ॥ 13 ॥

1.24.s:
sādhuḥ sadvaṃśajāṃ kanyāṃ prayatnena parigrahet ..
tasyāṃ putrānsamutpādya vṛddhastu tapase vrajet .. 14 ..
1.24.d:
साधुः सद्वंशजां कन्यां प्रयत्नेन परिग्रहेत् ॥
तस्यां पुत्रान्समुत्पाद्य वृद्धस्तु तपसे व्रजेत् ॥ 14 ॥

1.24.s:
varaṃ hutavahe vāsaḥ sarpavaktre ca kaṇṭake ..
etebhyo duḥkhado vāsaḥ striyā durmukhayā saha .. 15 ..
1.24.d:
वरं हुतवहे वासः सर्पवक्त्रे च कण्टके ॥
एतेभ्यो दुःखदो वासः स्त्रिया दुर्मुखया सह ॥ 15 ॥

1.24.s:
matto'dhītastvayā vedo mahyaṃ ca gurudakṣiṇām ..
putra dehīdameveha kuru dāraparigraham .. 16 ..
1.24.d:
मत्तोऽधीतस्त्वया वेदो मह्यं च गुरुदक्षिणाम् ॥
पुत्र देहीदमेवेह कुरु दारपरिग्रहम् ॥ 16 ॥

1.24.s:
vatsa tvaṃ kulajātāṃ ca pūrvapatnī ca mālatīm ..
vivāhaṃ kuru kalyāṇa kalyāṇe ca dine 'nagha .. 17 ..
1.24.d:
वत्स त्वं कुलजातां च पूर्वपत्नी च मालतीम् ॥
विवाहं कुरु कल्याण कल्याणे च दिने ऽनघ ॥ 17 ॥

1.24.s:
manuvaṃśodbhavasyeha sṛṃjayasya gṛhe satī ..
tvatkṛte janma labdhvā ca kurute bhārate tapaḥ .. 18 ..
1.24.d:
मनुवंशोद्भवस्येह सृंजयस्य गृहे सती ॥
त्वत्कृते जन्म लब्ध्वा च कुरुते भारते तपः ॥ 18 ॥

1.24.s:
gṛhṇīṣva paramāṃ ratnamālāṃ ca kamalākalām ..
bhārate na bhavedvyarthaṃ janānāṃ tapasaḥ phalam .. 19 ..
1.24.d:
गृह्णीष्व परमां रत्नमालां च कमलाकलाम् ॥
भारते न भवेद्व्यर्थं जनानां तपसः फलम् ॥ 19 ॥

1.24.s:
ādau bhavedgṛhī loko vānaprasthastataḥ param ..
tatasta pasvī mokṣāya krama eṣa śrutau śrutaḥ .. 1.24.20 ..
1.24.d:
आदौ भवेद्गृही लोको वानप्रस्थस्ततः परम् ॥
ततस्त पस्वी मोक्षाय क्रम एष श्रुतौ श्रुतः ॥ 1.24.20 ॥

1.24.s: vaiṣṇavānāṃ harerarcā tapasyā ca śrutau śrutā .. 21 ..
1.24.d: वैष्णवानां हरेरर्चा तपस्या च श्रुतौ श्रुता ॥ 21 ॥

1.24.s:
vaiṣṇava tvaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭha kuru kṛṣṇapadārcanam ..
antarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā suta .. 22 ..
1.24.d:
वैष्णव त्वं गृहे तिष्ठ कुरु कृष्णपदार्चनम् ॥
अन्तर्बाह्ये हरिर्यस्य तस्य किं तपसा सुत ॥ 22 ॥

1.24.s:
nāntarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā'nagha ..
tapasā harirārādhyo nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate .. 23 ..
1.24.d:
नान्तर्बाह्ये हरिर्यस्य तस्य किं तपसाऽनघ ॥
तपसा हरिराराध्यो नान्यः कश्चन विद्यते ॥ 23 ॥

1.24.s:
yatra tatra kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasevanaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ..
vatsa madvacanenaiva gṛhe sthitvā hariṃ bhaja.. 24 ..
1.24.d:
यत्र तत्र कृतं कृष्णसेवनं परमं तपः ॥
वत्स मद्वचनेनैव गृहे स्थित्वा हरिं भज॥ 24 ॥
1.24.m:
Service rendered to Kṛṣṇa anywhere at all is the supreme austerity.
My child, by my word alone, stay at home and worship Hari! // 24

1.24.s:
gṛhī bhava muniśreṣṭha gṛhiṇāṃ sarvadā sukham ..
kāminyāṃ sukhasambhogaḥ svargabhogasamo mataḥ .. 25 ..
1.24.d:
गृही भव मुनिश्रेष्ठ गृहिणां सर्वदा सुखम् ॥
कामिन्यां सुखसम्भोगः स्वर्गभोगसमो मतः ॥ 25 ॥
1.24.m:
Become a householder, O best of sages! For householders there is always happiness.
Pleasurable enjoyment with a lovely woman is considered equal to the enjoyment of heaven. // 25

1.24.s:
taddarśanamupasparśaṃ vāñchantyeva mumukṣavaḥ ..
sarvasparśasukhātstrīṇāmupasparśasukhaṃ param..26..
1.24.d:
तद्दर्शनमुपस्पर्शं वाञ्छन्त्येव मुमुक्षवः ॥
सर्वस्पर्शसुखात्स्त्रीणामुपस्पर्शसुखं परम्॥26॥
1.24.m:
Even those desiring liberation indeed desire her sight and touch.
The pleasure of embracing women is supreme above all tactile pleasures. // 26

1.24.s:
tataḥ sukhatamaṃ putradarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ mune ..
sarvebhyaḥ preyasī kāntā priyā tena prakīrttitā .. ..27..
1.24.d:
ततः सुखतमं पुत्रदर्शनं स्पर्शनं मुने ॥
सर्वेभ्यः प्रेयसी कान्ता प्रिया तेन प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ ॥27॥
1.24.m:
Still more delightful than that, O sage, is the sight and touch of a son.
A beloved wife is dearer than all; therefore she is celebrated as 'beloved'. // 27

1.24.s:
putraprayojanā kāntā śatakāntāpriyaḥ sutaḥ ..
nāsti putrātparo bandhurnāsti putrātparaḥ priyaḥ .. 28..
1.24.d:
पुत्रप्रयोजना कान्ता शतकान्ताप्रियः सुतः ॥
नास्ति पुत्रात्परो बन्धुर्नास्ति पुत्रात्परः प्रियः ॥ 28॥
1.24.m:
A wife has a son as her purpose; a son is dearer than a hundred wives.
There is no relative greater than a son; there is no one dearer than a son. // 28

1.24.s:
sarvebhyo jayamanvicchetputrādekātparājayam ..
na cātmani priyo'rthaśca tasmādapi sutaḥ priyaḥ .. 29 ..
1.24.d:
सर्वेभ्यो जयमन्विच्छेत्पुत्रादेकात्पराजयम् ॥
न चात्मनि प्रियोऽर्थश्च तस्मादपि सुतः प्रियः ॥ 29 ॥
1.24.m:
One should desire victory from everyone, but defeat from a son alone.
Even wealth is not dearer than oneself, yet a son is dearer even than that. // 29

1.24.s:
ataḥ priyatame putre nyasedātmaparaṃ dhanam ..
ityevamuktvā sa brahmā virarāma ca śaunaka ..
uvāca vacanaṃ tātaṃ nārado jñānināṃ varaḥ .. 1.24.30 ..
1.24.d:
अतः प्रियतमे पुत्रे न्यसेदात्मपरं धनम् ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स ब्रह्मा विरराम च शौनक ॥
उवाच वचनं तातं नारदो ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥ 1.24.30 ॥
1.24.m:
Therefore one should bestow on the dearest son wealth higher than oneself."
Having spoken thus, O Śaunaka, that Brahmā paused.
Then Nārada, the best of the wise, spoke words to his father. // 30

1.24.s:
nārada uvāca ..
svayaṃ vijñāya sarvārthaṃ svaputraṃ vedadarśane ..
pravarttayatyasanmārge sa dayāluḥ kathaṃ pitā ..31..
1.24.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
स्वयं विज्ञाय सर्वार्थं स्वपुत्रं वेददर्शने ॥
प्रवर्त्तयत्यसन्मार्गे स दयालुः कथं पिता ॥31॥
1.24.m:
"Knowing all truths himself through Vedic vision,
how can a father who directs his own son onto a bad path be compassionate? // 31

1.24.s:
jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāramatinaśvaram ..
jalarekhā yathā mithyā tathā brahmañjagattrayam .. 32 ..
1.24.d:
जलबुद्बुदवत्सर्वं संसारमतिनश्वरम् ॥
जलरेखा यथा मिथ्या तथा ब्रह्मञ्जगत्त्रयम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.24.m:
The entire transmigratory world is like a water-bubble, extremely transitory.
Just as a line drawn on water is unreal, so is the triad of worlds, O Brahman. // 32

1.24.s:
vihāya haridāsyaṃ ca viṣaye yanmanaścalam ..
durlabhaṃ mānavaṃ janma mā bhūttanniṣphalaṃ kvacit .. 33 ..
1.24.d:
विहाय हरिदास्यं च विषये यन्मनश्चलम् ॥
दुर्लभं मानवं जन्म मा भूत्तन्निष्फलं क्वचित् ॥ 33 ॥
1.24.m:
Leaving aside servitude to Hari, the mind that wavers among sense-objects
makes this rare human birth fruitless—may it never be so! // 33

1.24.s:
kā vā kasya priyā putro bandhuḥ ko vā bhavārṇave ..
karmormibhiryojanā ca tadapāyo viyojanā .. 34 ..
1.24.d:
का वा कस्य प्रिया पुत्रो बन्धुः को वा भवार्णवे ॥
कर्मोर्मिभिर्योजना च तदपायो वियोजना ॥ 34 ॥
1.24.m:
Who is whose beloved, son, or kinsman in the ocean of worldly existence?
Union is brought about by the waves of karma, and their cessation brings separation. // 34

1.24.s:
sukarma kārayedyo hi tanmitraṃ sa pitā guruḥ ..
durbuddhiṃ janayedyo hi sa ripuḥ syātkathaṃ pitā .. 35 ..
1.24.d:
सुकर्म कारयेद्यो हि तन्मित्रं स पिता गुरुः ॥
दुर्बुद्धिं जनयेद्यो हि स रिपुः स्यात्कथं पिता ॥ 35 ॥
1.24.m:
He who causes one to perform good deeds is indeed a friend, a father, a guru;
he who generates bad counsel would be an enemy—how could he be a father? // 35

1.24.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta vedabījaṃ yathāgamam ..
dhruvaṃ tathā'pi karttavyaṃ tavājñāparipālanam .. 36 ..
1.24.d:
इत्येवं कथितं तात वेदबीजं यथागमम् ॥
ध्रुवं तथाऽपि कर्त्तव्यं तवाज्ञापरिपालनम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.24.m:
Thus the root of the Veda has been spoken by me in accordance with tradition, O father.
Even so, the fulfillment of your command must certainly be done. // 36

1.24.s:
ādau yāsyāmi bhagavannaranārāyaṇāśramam ..
nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrutvā kariṣye dārasaṃgraham ..37..
1.24.d:
आदौ यास्यामि भगवन्नरनारायणाश्रमम् ॥
नारायणकथां श्रुत्वा करिष्ये दारसंग्रहम् ॥37॥
1.24.m:
First I shall go, O Lord, to the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa;
having heard the narratives of Nārāyaṇa, I shall take a wife." // 37

1.24.s:
ityevamuktvā sa munirvirarāma pituḥ puraḥ ..
puṣpavṛṣṭistadupari tatkṣaṇena babhūva ha .. 38 ..
1.24.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स मुनिर्विरराम पितुः पुरः ॥
पुष्पवृष्टिस्तदुपरि तत्क्षणेन बभूव ह ॥ 38 ॥
1.24.m:
Having spoken thus before his father, the sage fell silent.
At that very instant, a shower of flowers fell upon him. // 38

1.24.s:
kṣaṇaṃ pituḥ puraḥ sthitvā nārado munisattamaḥ ..
uvāca ca punarvedaṃ vacanaṃ maṅgalapradam .. 39 ..
1.24.d:
क्षणं पितुः पुरः स्थित्वा नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ॥
उवाच च पुनर्वेदं वचनं मङ्गलप्रदम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.24.m:
Standing for a moment before his father, Nārada, the best of sages,
again spoke words conforming to the Veda and bringing auspiciousness. // 39

1.24.s:
śrīnārada uvāca ..
dehi me kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca yanmanovāñchitaṃ mama ..
tatsambandhi ca yajjñānaṃ yatra tadguṇavarṇanam.. 1.24.40 ..
1.24.d:
श्रीनारद उवाच ॥
देहि मे कृष्णमन्त्रं च यन्मनोवाञ्छितं मम ॥
तत्सम्बन्धि च यज्ज्ञानं यत्र तद्गुणवर्णनम्॥ 1.24.40 ॥
1.24.m:
"Give me the mantra of Kṛṣṇa, which my heart desires,
and the knowledge relating to him, wherein his qualities are described.

1.24.s:
tataḥ paścātkariṣyāmi tvatprītyā dārasaṃgraham ..
mānase paripūrṇe ca kāryyaṃ kartuṃ pumānsukhī..41..
1.24.d:
ततः पश्चात्करिष्यामि त्वत्प्रीत्या दारसंग्रहम् ॥
मानसे परिपूर्णे च कार्य्यं कर्तुं पुमान्सुखी॥41॥
1.24.m:
After that, out of love for you, I will take a wife.
When a man's heart is satisfied, he happily performs his duty."

1.24.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ..
uvāca punarevedaṃ putraṃ jñānavidāṃ varaḥ .. 42 ..
1.24.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहृष्टः कमलोद्भवः ॥
उवाच पुनरेवेदं पुत्रं ज्ञानविदां वरः ॥ 42 ॥
1.24.m:
Hearing Nārada's words, the lotus-born [Brahmā] was delighted;
the foremost knower of knowledge spoke again to his son:

1.24.s:
brahmovāca ..
patyurmantraṃ piturmantraṃ na gṛhṇīyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
viviktāśramiṇāṃ caiva na mantraḥ sukhadāyakaḥ .. 43 ..
1.24.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
पत्युर्मन्त्रं पितुर्मन्त्रं न गृह्णीयाद्विचक्षणः ॥
विविक्ताश्रमिणां चैव न मन्त्रः सुखदायकः ॥ 43 ॥
1.24.m:
"A wise man should not take a mantra from a husband or a father;
and for those of separate orders of life, a mantra does not bestow happiness.

1.24.s:
niṣekāllabhyate mantro gururbharttā ca kāminī..
vidyā sukhaṃ bhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ puruṣaiḥ svecchayā na ca .. 44 ..
1.24.d:
निषेकाल्लभ्यते मन्त्रो गुरुर्भर्त्ता च कामिनी॥
विद्या सुखं भयं दुःखं पुरुषैः स्वेच्छया न च ॥ 44 ॥
1.24.m:
A mantra, a guru, a husband, and a desirable woman are obtained through destiny;
knowledge, happiness, fear, and sorrow are not [obtained] by men according to their own desire.

1.24.s:
maheśvarastava guruḥ prāktano naḥ purātanaḥ ..
gaccha vatsa śivaṃ śāntaṃ śivadaṃ jñānināṃ gurum .. 45 ..
1.24.d:
महेश्वरस्तव गुरुः प्राक्तनो नः पुरातनः ॥
गच्छ वत्स शिवं शान्तं शिवदं ज्ञानिनां गुरुम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.24.m:
Maheśvara is your guru from before, [and] our ancient [guide].
Go, child, to Śiva, tranquil, the giver of auspiciousness, the guru of the wise.

1.24.s:
tata eva bhavānmantraṃ jñānaṃ labdhvā purātanāt ..
nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrutvā śīghramāgaccha madgṛham .. 46 ..
1.24.d:
तत एव भवान्मन्त्रं ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा पुरातनात् ॥
नारायणकथां श्रुत्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ मद्गृहम् ॥ 46 ॥
1.24.m:
Having obtained mantra and knowledge from him, the ancient one,
and having heard the narrative of Nārāyaṇa, return quickly to my home."

1.24.s:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca śaunaka ..
praṇamya pitaraṃ bhaktyā śivalokaṃ yayau muniḥ .. 47 ..
1.24.d:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता विरराम च शौनक ॥
प्रणम्य पितरं भक्त्या शिवलोकं ययौ मुनिः ॥ 47 ॥
1.24.m:
Having spoken thus, the creator of the worlds ceased, O Śaunaka.
Bowing to his father with devotion, the sage went to the realm of Śiva.

1.25.s:
sautiruvāca ..
kṣaṇena viprapravaro mudā'nvito jagāma śambhoḥ sadanaṃ manoharam ..
ūrdhvaṃ dhruvādyojanalakṣamīpsitaṃ mahārharatnaughavinirmitaṃ mahat .. 1 ..
1.25.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
क्षणेन विप्रप्रवरो मुदाऽन्वितो जगाम शम्भोः सदनं मनोहरम् ॥
ऊर्ध्वं ध्रुवाद्योजनलक्षमीप्सितं महार्हरत्नौघविनिर्मितं महत् ॥ 1 ॥

1.25.s:
nirāśraye yogabalena śambhunā dhṛtaṃ vicitraṃ vividhālayānvitam ..
dṛṣṭaṃ supuṇyāśayasādhakairvarairmunīndravaryaiḥ paripūritaṃ śubham .. 2 ..
1.25.d:
निराश्रये योगबलेन शम्भुना धृतं विचित्रं विविधालयान्वितम् ॥
दृष्टं सुपुण्याशयसाधकैर्वरैर्मुनीन्द्रवर्यैः परिपूरितं शुभम् ॥ 2 ॥

1.25.s:
puraṃ varaṃ yojanalakṣavistṛtaṃ trikoṭiratnendragṛhānvitaṃ sadā ..
virājitaṃ hīrakasāranirmitaiścitrairvicitrairvividhairmanoharaiḥ .. 4 ..
1.25.d:
पुरं वरं योजनलक्षविस्तृतं त्रिकोटिरत्नेन्द्रगृहान्वितं सदा ॥
विराजितं हीरकसारनिर्मितैश्चित्रैर्विचित्रैर्विविधैर्मनोहरैः ॥ 4 ॥

1.25.s:
māṇikyamuktāmaṇidarpaṇairyutaṃ nasvapnadṛṣṭaṃ dvija viśvakarmaṇaḥ ..
ākalpamekaiḥ śivasevitairjanairniṣevitaṃ santatameva śaunaka .. 5 ..
1.25.d:
माणिक्यमुक्तामणिदर्पणैर्युतं नस्वप्नदृष्टं द्विज विश्वकर्मणः ॥
आकल्पमेकैः शिवसेवितैर्जनैर्निषेवितं सन्ततमेव शौनक ॥ 5 ॥

1.25.s:
siddhairniyuktaṃ śatakoṭilakṣaikaistrikoṭilakṣaiśca yutaṃ svapārṣadaiḥ ..
yuktaṃ trilakṣairvikaṭaiśca bhairavaiḥ kṣetraiścaturlakṣaśataiśca veṣṭitam .. 6 ..
1.25.d:
सिद्धैर्नियुक्तं शतकोटिलक्षैकैस्त्रिकोटिलक्षैश्च युतं स्वपार्षदैः ॥
युक्तं त्रिलक्षैर्विकटैश्च भैरवैः क्षेत्रैश्चतुर्लक्षशतैश्च वेष्टितम् ॥ 6 ॥

1.25.s:
suradrumairveṣṭitameva santataṃ mandāravṛkṣapravaraiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ ..
virājitaṃ sundarakāmadhenubhiryathā balākāśatakairnabhastalam .. 7 ..
1.25.d:
सुरद्रुमैर्वेष्टितमेव सन्ततं मन्दारवृक्षप्रवरैः सुपुष्पितैः ॥
विराजितं सुन्दरकामधेनुभिर्यथा बलाकाशतकैर्नभस्तलम् ॥ 7 ॥

1.25.s:
dṛṣṭvā munirvismayamāpa mānase kiṃ nātra citraṃ surayogināṃ gurau ..
lokaṃ trilokācca vilakṣaṇaṃ paraṃ bhīmṛtyurogārttijarāharaṃ varam .. 8 ..
1.25.d:
दृष्ट्वा मुनिर्विस्मयमाप मानसे किं नात्र चित्रं सुरयोगिनां गुरौ ॥
लोकं त्रिलोकाच्च विलक्षणं परं भीमृत्युरोगार्त्तिजराहरं वरम् ॥ 8 ॥

1.25.s:
dūre sabhāmaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ śivaṃ dadarśa śāntaṃ śivadaṃ manoharam ..
padmatrinetraṃ vidhupañcavaktraṃ gaṅgādharaṃ nirmalacandraśekharam .. 9 ..
1.25.d:
दूरे सभामण्डलमध्यगं शिवं ददर्श शान्तं शिवदं मनोहरम् ॥
पद्मत्रिनेत्रं विधुपञ्चवक्त्रं गङ्गाधरं निर्मलचन्द्रशेखरम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.25.m: lotus-three-eyed, moon-five-faced, the bearer of the Gaṅgā, adorned with the spotless moon on his crest,

1.25.s:
prataptahemābhajaṭādharaṃ vibhuṃ digambaraṃ śubhramanantamakṣaram ..
mandākinīpuṣkarabījamālayā kṛṣṇeti nāmaiva mudā japantam .. 1.25.10 ..
1.25.d:
प्रतप्तहेमाभजटाधरं विभुं दिगम्बरं शुभ्रमनन्तमक्षरम् ॥
मन्दाकिनीपुष्करबीजमालया कृष्णेति नामैव मुदा जपन्तम् ॥ 1.25.10 ॥
1.25.m:
bearing matted hair resembling molten gold, the all-pervading lord, sky-clad, white, endless, imperishable,
joyfully chanting the very name "Kṛṣṇa" on a rosary of lotus seeds from the Mandākinī,

1.25.s:
sunīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhujagendramaṇḍitaṃ yogīndrasiddhendra munīndravanditam ..
siddheśvaraṃ siddhavidhānakāraṇaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ kālayamāntakārakam .. 11 ..
1.25.d:
सुनीलकण्ठं भुजगेन्द्रमण्डितं योगीन्द्रसिद्धेन्द्र मुनीन्द्रवन्दितम् ॥
सिद्धेश्वरं सिद्धविधानकारणं मृत्युंजयं कालयमान्तकारकम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.25.m:
with a beautiful dark-blue throat, adorned by the king of serpents, praised by the lords of yogins, lords of siddhas, and foremost sages,
the lord of siddhas, the cause of the performance of perfection, the conqueror of death, the bringer of the end to Time and Yama,

1.25.s:
prasannahāsyāsyamanoharaṃ varaṃ viśvāśrayāṇāṃ śivadaṃ varapradam ..
sadā''śutoṣaṃ bhavarogavarjitaṃ bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktajanaikabandhum .. 12 ..
1.25.d:
प्रसन्नहास्यास्यमनोहरं वरं विश्वाश्रयाणां शिवदं वरप्रदम् ॥
सदा'ऽशुतोषं भवरोगवर्जितं भक्तप्रियं भक्तजनैकबन्धुम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.25.m:
charming with a gracious, smiling face, supreme, the giver of auspiciousness to those whose refuge is the universe, the bestower of boons,
ever easily pleased, free from the disease of worldly existence, dear to devotees, the sole friend of devout people.

1.25.s:
gatvā samīpaṃ munireṣa śūlinaṃ nanāma mūrdhnā pulakāṅkavigrahaḥ ..
vīṇāṃ tritantrīṃ kvaṇayanpunarjagau kṛṣṇaṃ sa tuṣṭāva kalaṃ sukaṇṭhaḥ .. 13 ..
1.25.d:
गत्वा समीपं मुनिरेष शूलिनं ननाम मूर्ध्ना पुलकाङ्कविग्रहः ॥
वीणां त्रितन्त्रीं क्वणयन्पुनर्जगौ कृष्णं स तुष्टाव कलं सुकण्ठः ॥ 13 ॥
1.25.m:
Approaching him, that sage bowed with his head to the bearer of the trident, his body bristling with horripilation;
sounding his three-stringed vīṇā, sweet-voiced, he sang again of Kṛṣṇa and praised him melodiously.

1.25.s:
dṛṣṭvā munīndrapravaraṃ ca sasmitaṃ vidheḥ sutaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭham ..
yogīndrasiddhendramaharṣibhiḥ samaṃ harṣeṇa pīṭhādudapaśyadīśvaraḥ .. 14 ..
1.25.d:
दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्द्रप्रवरं च सस्मितं विधेः सुतं वेदविदां वरिष्ठम् ॥
योगीन्द्रसिद्धेन्द्रमहर्षिभिः समं हर्षेण पीठादुदपश्यदीश्वरः ॥ 14 ॥
1.25.m:
Seeing the foremost lord of sages smiling, the son of Brahmā, the highest among knowers of the Veda,
the Lord [Śiva], together with lords of yogins, lords of siddhas, and great ṛṣis, joyfully looked up from his seat.

1.25.s:
dadau ca tasmai munaye sa saṃbhramādāliṅganaṃ cāśiṣamāsanādikam ..
papraccha bhadrāgamanaprayojanaṃ tapodhanaṃ taṃ tapasā ca śaunaka .. 15 ..
1.25.d:
ददौ च तस्मै मुनये स संभ्रमादालिङ्गनं चाशिषमासनादिकम् ॥
पप्रच्छ भद्रागमनप्रयोजनं तपोधनं तं तपसा च शौनक ॥ 15 ॥
1.25.m:
With respectful haste he gave that sage an embrace, a blessing, a seat, and the like;
and he inquired into the purpose of the auspicious arrival of that [sage] rich in asceticism, O Śaunaka.

1.25.s:
sadratnasiṃhāsanasundare paraścovāsa śambhurvarapārṣadaiḥ saha ..
novāsa dhātustanayaḥ kṛtāñjalistuṣṭāva bhaktyā praṇataḥ prabhuṃ dvija .. 16..
1.25.d:
सद्रत्नसिंहासनसुन्दरे परश्चोवास शम्भुर्वरपार्षदैः सह ॥
नोवास धातुस्तनयः कृताञ्जलिस्तुष्टाव भक्त्या प्रणतः प्रभुं द्विज ॥ 16॥
1.25.m:
The supreme Śambhu sat down upon a beautiful lion-throne of genuine gems, together with his noble attendants;
the creator's son did not sit, but, folding his hands and bowing low, praised the Lord with devotion, O twice-born.

1.25.s:
gandharvarājena kṛtena nāradaḥ stotreṇa ramyeṇa śubhapradena ca ..
stutvā praṇāmaṃ punareva kṛtvā bhavājñayovāsa bhavasya vāmataḥ .. 17 ..
1.25.d:
गन्धर्वराजेन कृतेन नारदः स्तोत्रेण रम्येण शुभप्रदेन च ॥
स्तुत्वा प्रणामं पुनरेव कृत्वा भवाज्ञयोवास भवस्य वामतः ॥ 17 ॥
1.25.m:
Nārada, having praised him with the charming, auspicious hymn composed by the king of Gandharvas,
and having bowed once more, sat on Bhava's left side by Bhava's command.

1.25.s:
cakāra tatraiva nivedanaṃ śive mano'bhilāṣaṃ nijakāmapūrake ..
śrutvā munestadvacanaṃ kṛpānidhirdrutaṃ pratijñāya cakāra comiti .. 18 ..
1.25.d:
चकार तत्रैव निवेदनं शिवे मनोऽभिलाषं निजकामपूरके ॥
श्रुत्वा मुनेस्तद्वचनं कृपानिधिर्द्रुतं प्रतिज्ञाय चकार चोमिति ॥ 18 ॥
1.25.m:
There he made known his heart's desire to Śiva, the fulfiller of his wishes;
hearing the sage's words, the ocean of compassion quickly promised and said, "Om."
